chapters.title: Chapter 1875: Using the Universe.
paragraphs: "Then… are we going to abandon the foxes?"
At that question, Nux smiled mischievously.
"I said we stand no chance in a direct confrontation.
Who said we are going to do that?
It is time to use our long-time enemy to our advantage."
"Our long-time enemy?"
Felberta frowned.
Nux, however, simply opened a portal and signaled Felberta to walk in.
"Let’s meet the rest, shall we?"
"Alright…" Enjoy new chapters from freewebnovel
The Eldraeth Progenitor nodded as she walked in.
Since Nux decided to involve everyone, she knew it was a big deal.
As she walked into the Core, she noticed that the rest of the women were here as well. Riona, Lane, and others had moved and gathered all of them.
Eisheth, Aeliana, Lyriana, all of them were here.
"What a sight~"

Nux whistled perversely as he stared at the group of goddesses gathered right in front of him. Every single one of these women was an absolute beauty. Being surrounded by them all… Nux couldn’t help but feel surreal.
"Stop staring at us and tell us what you were thinking."
While Nux was relishing the moment, Vyriana spoke up.
"What did you mean when you said you are going to use our enemy to our advantage?"
She questioned, her voice cold and unforgiving.
It was clear that the Dragon was worried that Nux would do something reckless again. The rest of the women were the same.
Amaya, on the other hand, had a rough idea.
"Nux…"
She called out.
Nux turned towards her, and the devourer questioned,
"Are you talking about the Universe?"
There were a few candidates in the devourer’s mind when it came to enemies, however, the moment she thought from Nux’s perspective, the list narrowed down quite a bit.
After all, this man only considered an entity his ’enemy’ when he/she/it targeted his wives, and…
Other than the Universe, everyone else who had tried to do that is either dead or has suffered a fate far worse than death.
"You understand me so well."
Nux praised as he glanced at his devourer.
Amaya lowered her head a bit and smiled. Then, she secretly glanced at Aeliana, who seemed to be looking at her as well.
The two women exchanged glances, but before something could happen,
"The Universe? How are you planning to use the Universe?"
Vyriana questioned.
"He wants to direct the Universe’s attention to those worlds and use it to destroy them."
Instead of Nux, Aeliana was the one who answered, and seeing how Nux’s smile widened at those words, the women understood that the Vampire was correct.
Aeliana smirked as she glanced at Amaya.
Amaya snorted. Vyriana, on the other hand, continued with her questions.
"And how is he going to do that?"
"Kidnapping beings from those five worlds, throwing them to other lower-level worlds, before bringing them back and devouring those worlds."
Aeliana answered.
"What…?"
Vyriana frowned.
"We kidnap beings from those five middle-level worlds, throw them to a low-level world Ember and others had found out about, before we bring them back, and later Nux would go and devour that world.
Basically, we are trying to create a link between those middle-level worlds and the worlds the ’Anomaly’ devours."
Amaya explained as she stared at Aeliana.
The devourer had the same line of thought.
Actually, this wasn’t the first time she had thought of this method, but since they never needed to do something like this, she never suggested it.
Once again, the devourer and the Vampire stared at each other. The rest of the women, especially Allura and Aisha, stared at the scene with amused and curious eyes, but then,
Aeliana and Amaya nodded at each other and,

"Till now, we were trying to not link the Anomaly’s actions with Yrniel, but now, we are going to purposefully link the Anomaly’s actions with these five worlds. Our final goal is to use the Universe to get rid of these worlds in our stead."
Amaya continued to explain.
"Of course, this will not happen instantly. The first few times, the Universe would probably only devour those five beings and continue to show its anger, but…
What if, after it devours those five beings, another batch of beings, from the same world as before, enters another world, before that world is devoured as well?
Even if the Universe devours these five beings as well…
What if… this process continues to repeat…?
Again and again and again,
No matter how many times the Universe devours these beings, more, from the same worlds, appear, ’inspect’ another world, before the Anomaly destroys that world.
What do you think the Universe would do?"
Amaya questioned, and the women’s expressions changed.
"Actually, we can make it even more appealing."
Suddenly, Aeliana spoke up, and with an expression similar to Amaya’s on her face, the Vampire continued,
"What if… every time the Universe tries to devour these beings, the Anomaly appears and devours them instead? Stealing them away from it?"
The smile on Aeliana’s face widened as she turned towards Nux and,
"After all, the Anomaly would never let its people be devoured by the Universe, now would it?"
"But that would limit the number of times we can do this…"
Amaya muttered with a frown.
She liked the idea but… she didn’t want to work with restrictions.
Her mind worked quickly and,

"Keeping the spots for others and a few more for emergencies, Nux should only have around 100 spots. If he needs to devour 5 beings every time he devours a world, that means he can only devour 20 worlds.
Adding the 40 spots he gets from those worlds, he can devour 8 more, and the 16 spots he gets from them would allow him to devour 3 more…
That makes it a total of 31 worlds… that seems enough…"
Amaya nodded to herself, liking the idea even more now.
"Right?"
Aeliana’s smile widened.
"31 worlds should be more than enough. With how impatient the Universe is, I’d say it would directly target those worlds before we hit the 10th world."
Amaya nodded back.
"Exactly."
The Vampire nodded as well.
The two women were forming a strange form of camaraderie.

sentences.text: "Then… are we going to abandon the foxes?"
At that question, Nux smiled mischievously.
"I said we stand no chance in a direct confrontation.
Who said we are going to do that?
It is time to use our long-time enemy to our advantage."
"Our long-time enemy?"
Felberta frowned.
Nux, however, simply opened a portal and signaled Felberta to walk in.
"Let’s meet the rest, shall we?"
"Alright…" Enjoy new chapters from freewebnovel
The Eldraeth Progenitor nodded as she walked in.
Since Nux decided to involve everyone, she knew it was a big deal.
As she walked into the Core, she noticed that the rest of the women were here as well.
Riona, Lane, and others had moved and gathered all of them.
Eisheth, Aeliana, Lyriana, all of them were here.
"What a sight~"
Nux whistled perversely as he stared at the group of goddesses gathered right in front of him.
Every single one of these women was an absolute beauty.
Being surrounded by them all…
Nux couldn’t help but feel surreal.
"Stop staring at us and tell us what you were thinking."
While Nux was relishing the moment, Vyriana spoke up.
"What did you mean when you said you are going to use our enemy to our advantage?"
She questioned, her voice cold and unforgiving.
It was clear that the Dragon was worried that Nux would do something reckless again.
The rest of the women were the same.
Amaya, on the other hand, had a rough idea.
"Nux…"
She called out.
Nux turned towards her, and the devourer questioned,
"Are you talking about the Universe?"
There were a few candidates in the devourer’s mind when it came to enemies, however, the moment she thought from Nux’s perspective, the list narrowed down quite a bit.
After all, this man only considered an entity his ’enemy’ when he/she/it targeted his wives, and…
Other than the Universe, everyone else who had tried to do that is either dead or has suffered a fate far worse than death.
"You understand me so well."
Nux praised as he glanced at his devourer.
Amaya lowered her head a bit and smiled.
Then, she secretly glanced at Aeliana, who seemed to be looking at her as well.
The two women exchanged glances, but before something could happen,
"The Universe?
How are you planning to use the Universe?"
Vyriana questioned.
"He wants to direct the Universe’s attention to those worlds and use it to destroy them."
Instead of Nux, Aeliana was the one who answered, and seeing how Nux’s smile widened at those words, the women understood that the Vampire was correct.
Aeliana smirked as she glanced at Amaya.
Amaya snorted.
Vyriana, on the other hand, continued with her questions.
"And how is he going to do that?"
"Kidnapping beings from those five worlds, throwing them to other lower-level worlds, before bringing them back and devouring those worlds."
Aeliana answered.
"What…?"
Vyriana frowned.
"We kidnap beings from those five middle-level worlds, throw them to a low-level world Ember and others had found out about, before we bring them back, and later Nux would go and devour that world.
Basically, we are trying to create a link between those middle-level worlds and the worlds the ’Anomaly’ devours."
Amaya explained as she stared at Aeliana.
The devourer had the same line of thought.
Actually, this wasn’t the first time she had thought of this method, but since they never needed to do something like this, she never suggested it.
Once again, the devourer and the Vampire stared at each other.
The rest of the women, especially Allura and Aisha, stared at the scene with amused and curious eyes, but then,
Aeliana and Amaya nodded at each other and,
"Till now, we were trying to not link the Anomaly’s actions with Yrniel, but now, we are going to purposefully link the Anomaly’s actions with these five worlds.
Our final goal is to use the Universe to get rid of these worlds in our stead."
Amaya continued to explain.
"Of course, this will not happen instantly.
The first few times, the Universe would probably only devour those five beings and continue to show its anger, but…
What if, after it devours those five beings, another batch of beings, from the same world as before, enters another world, before that world is devoured as well?
Even if the Universe devours these five beings as well…
What if… this process continues to repeat…?
Again and again and again,
No matter how many times the Universe devours these beings, more, from the same worlds, appear, ’inspect’ another world, before the Anomaly destroys that world.
What do you think the Universe would do?"
Amaya questioned, and the women’s expressions changed.
"Actually, we can make it even more appealing."
Suddenly, Aeliana spoke up, and with an expression similar to Amaya’s on her face, the Vampire continued,
"What if… every time the Universe tries to devour these beings, the Anomaly appears and devours them instead?
Stealing them away from it?"
The smile on Aeliana’s face widened as she turned towards Nux and,
"After all, the Anomaly would never let its people be devoured by the Universe, now would it?"
"But that would limit the number of times we can do this…"
Amaya muttered with a frown.
She liked the idea but… she didn’t want to work with restrictions.
Her mind worked quickly and,
"Keeping the spots for others and a few more for emergencies, Nux should only have around 100 spots.
If he needs to devour 5 beings every time he devours a world, that means he can only devour 20 worlds.
Adding the 40 spots he gets from those worlds, he can devour 8 more, and the 16 spots he gets from them would allow him to devour 3 more…
That makes it a total of 31 worlds… that seems enough…"
Amaya nodded to herself, liking the idea even more now.
"Right?"
Aeliana’s smile widened.
"31 worlds should be more than enough.
With how impatient the Universe is, I’d say it would directly target those worlds before we hit the 10th world."
Amaya nodded back.
"Exactly."
The Vampire nodded as well.
The two women were forming a strange form of camaraderie.

chapters.title: Chapter 1876: My way is much more direct.
paragraphs: "31 Worlds should be more than enough. With how impatient the Universe is, I’d say it would directly target those worlds before we hit the 10th world."
Amaya nodded.
"Exactly."
Aeliana nodded as well. Then, the Vampire continued,
"And it is not just about dealing with those Middle-Level Worlds. This method has quite a few other benefits as well."
"What do you mean?"
Vyriana questioned.
"Think of this as an experiment."
Aeliana answered.
The rest of the women, except Amaya, frowned in confusion, and the Vampire started.
"We need to understand how the Universe works.
What we are up against is the Universe, an entity with absolute power but limited intelligence.
We need to understand how far it is willing to go to get what it wants.
We need to test its boundaries.
We need to see how it would retaliate against our actions."
As the women listened intently, Amaya took over.
"What we are trying to understand is how many ’passes’ we have.
Our journey against the Universe is a long one. We cannot just sit back and let everything stay the same.
What we are trying to do is treat those five beings we select as if they are five of us.
We are connecting those five beings to the Anomaly, and once the Universe finds that out and tries to devour them, we are ’protecting’ those beings from the Universe’s retaliation.
It is similar to how, back then, Nux protected Felberta and then Mother."
Amaya explained, and Felberta finally got the gist of it.
"So you two are trying to find out how many ’chances’ or ’passes’ we have before the Universe targets Yrniel?"
"Exactly."
Aeliana nodded.
"As Amaya said, this is going to be a long journey. We cannot deny the possibility of there being a time when any one of us is connected to the Anomaly and the Universe tries to attack us.
The last thing we want is for the Universe to target Yrniel because of that.
Of course, we will do everything in our power to make sure that this doesn’t happen, but I still think it would be better to have a number in our mind."
The Vampire explained.
"But won’t the number change according to the circumstances? Especially in Yrniel’s case, since it already has a connection with the Anomaly?
Not to mention, the Universe will be much more sensitive to this after it devours five Middle-Level Worlds and still gets nothing out of it."
Astaria questioned with a frown.
"It will change, of course."
Aeliana nodded.
"But it would still be better to have a rough idea."
Amaya completed the sentence.
"And we can always weaken Yrniel’s connection with the Anomaly by strengthening the Anomaly’s connection to other worlds."
Aeliana added, and Amaya nodded at her words.
Honestly, the rest of the women who were seeing these two working together… weren’t liking it at all.
They honestly pitied their future enemies.
Just one Amaya was more than enough… but to add someone like Aeliana into the equation… the poor bastards wouldn’t even know what hit them.

Take those Middle-Level Worlds, for example. Imagine silently enjoying your day, in your world, without bothering anyone or anything, and then suddenly, the Universe attacks your world, reducing it to dust, ending your life without giving you a single chance to resist…
How pitiful was that?
The women shook their heads, praying for the poor souls who would stand against them in the future.

Nux, who saw their reaction, chuckled. He could tell what his lovely wives were thinking. Then, he turned towards Aeliana and Amaya, who were looking at him with bright eyes as if waiting for him to compliment them.
Of course, Amaya’s expression was much more open and shameless. The Vampire was still not very open yet, but even she was looking forward to Nux’s praise. Your next journey awaits at freewebnovel
But then,
"We cannot do that."
Nux shook his head.
"What? Why?"
Amaya frowned.
It wasn’t just her; Aeliana and the rest of the women frowned as well. They had just understood the plan and couldn’t help but like it more and more, but for Nux to disagree…
"While what you are thinking is good, it would attract a lot of attention to Yrniel."
Nux answered.
"Don’t forget, these Middle-Level Worlds are in the same Sector as Yrniel, and even if it is weak, they still have some sort of connection to Yrniel because of the foxes.
Not to mention, the first ’victim’ of the Anomaly came from Yrniel.
Just like Felberta said, it is already set in stone that the Anomaly has connections with Yrniel.
If any incident—especially one that angers the Universe to the point where it decides to devour the Worlds—occurs, it might target Yrniel too."
"It should not."
Aeliana shook her head.
Obviously, she had considered all this before.

"Their connection to Yrniel is very weak. They were only targeting Yrniel using the Low-Level Worlds because they were scared of Father. The only connection they have with Yrniel is the fact that they share the same Sector."
"And that is more than enough."
Nux answered.
"As I said, the Universe wouldn’t hesitate to burn itself if it meant it could get rid of the Anomaly.
While it might not devour the entire Sector, a world that had a connection with the Anomaly…
How likely do you think it is that the Universe would target such a world?"
Nux questioned, and in an instant, both Aeliana and Amaya turned silent.

They tried to think of ways around it, forming connections between other worlds of this Sector with the Anomaly by allowing Nux to devour entities from those worlds, but the more they thought about it…
The worse the idea felt.
After all, this would only attract more attention to this Sector.
It would become too dangerous.
"Then what were you planning to do when you said you were going to use our enemy to our advantage? Were you not talking about the Universe?"
Felberta questioned directly, and at that question,
Nux’s smile widened.
"Oh, I was talking about the Universe, alright."
He nodded.
"Just that my way is much more direct."

chapters.title: Chapter 1877: A Sovereign?
paragraphs: "Is he… really going to do it…?"
Lyriana questioned with a worried look on her face as she stared at the screen in front of her. A screen that showed Nux’s vision.
"You can sense his emotions, can’t you? You, of all people, should know the answer, don’t you think?"
Thyra questioned back.
"I… I am asking because I can sense his emotions…
It doesn’t seem like he is going to back down…"
Lyriana answered, her tone getting grimmer and grimmer with every second.
"…Don’t think too much about it.
He has thought this through."
Aeliana answered. However, unlike her words, her voice was unsure.
"I understand that, but… isn’t this still too risky…?"
Lyriana was worried.
"You are thinking too much."
Suddenly, Lane spoke up.
And as the women turned towards her, the Shadow Demon continued,
"He already explained everything, didn’t he? What’s bothering you?"
"That man is going to a Middle Lev-"
"This is not the first time he is doing something out of the ordinary. Using logic to assess his actions is foolish. So sit back, relax, and keep your mouth closed."
Lane waved her hand, dismissing Aeliana before she could even complete her words.
Seeing her act that way, the rest of the women narrowed their eyes.
"Sister Shadow…?"
Skyla called out.
After all, Sister Lane would never react that wa-
"The hell are you taking my name for!? I am not even there!"
A shout came from Felberta’s shadow.
The Eldraeth Progenitor looked down, and suddenly, Shadow materialized herself next to her.
"I am here, that one’s Lane."
She clarified.
After all, she couldn’t let her good name be tarnished.
The rest of the women, however, continued to doubt the situation.
"Lane would never act that way."
Thyra spoke out loud, finding everything more and more suspicious.
Did Shadow somehow take over Lane’s body?
It might be possible. After all, everything was possible in this universe.
Shadow, who could practically see the women’s thoughts on their faces, could feel her mouth twitching.
"Did you all forget? I am the side that woman hides from the rest of the world! What you are seeing is ’that side!’
I am not doing anything! That’s Lane!"
Shadow clarified her name.
"Why would she act like this?"
Thyra was still defensive.
After all, everyone knew what type of person Lane was.
"She is not in his shadow."
Shadow answered.
"What…?"
"Nux sent her away from his shadow, so she’s sulking."
"She’s… sulking…"
"That’s her way to do it, yes."
Shadow nodded, and the rest of the women turned towards Lane, who seemed annoyed by all the attention she was getting.
"Shadow, I swear if I can one day kill you, I will."
Lane threatened.
"The only one who can kill me is Nux."
Shadow answered.
Then, her smile widened, and
"He can fuck me to death. I’ll allow that."
The rest of the women, including Lane, turned silent.
Not reacting to Shadow’s words, the only one who stepped closer to Shadow was… Edda.
She was very much considering what the woman just said.
While the women were chatting, Nux, who had infiltrated Zendel, one of the Five Middle-Level Worlds, smiled.
The task couldn’t be easier for him since almost no world has a detection system that detects when a foreign entity infiltrates.
Every world relied on their World’s Will to do the work, and against someone like Nux, where the World’s Will fails, they were completely helpless.
Not that Nux was complaining; this made things easier for him. He was actually glad that was the case.
"Let’s start, shall we?"
Nux muttered as he stretched his body.
Then, he expanded his senses.
"Where do I start with?"
He wondered, and soon, he got the answer.
He placed his hand on the ground and suddenly, he connected with the ’Star’ inside his universe, gaining access to almost endless energy.

One thing to note was that after devouring almost ten new Low-Level Worlds and designating all of them as ’Stars’ in his universe, the amount of energy Nux now had access to had grown to an absurd level.
And no, it was not just a mere ten times growth.
No, before, Nux was using the energy of a Lowest-Level World. Now, however, he had more than ten Low-Level Worlds to rely on.
His energy reserves were truly that,
Endless.
And using these endless reserves, Nux started creating his Ice Domain.
The ice started from beneath his feet and expanded at a frightening rate.
With him as the center, it continued to expand forward, forming a circle whose radius continued to increase without stopping.
100 meters, 200 meters… 1000 meters… 10 kilometers… 1000 kilometers…
The Ice Domain continued to grow without stopping. As for the people who were caught within this domain?

Everyone below the Sovereign Stage froze that very instant. The Sovereigns were still able to move. They, however, were losing their movement speed because of the absurd cold, and while they could still resist, their bodies were giving out as the temperature around them continued to fall.
"What’s happening!?"
A Primordial Stage noble, who was enjoying his bath, shouted in anger as he noticed that the bathwater was frozen.
He stood up and noticed that the temperature around him had fallen to an absurdly low degree.
Frowning, he walked towards his window, and no matter how far he extended his vision, the only thing he could see was ice.
It was as if Zendel’s climate had suddenly flipped over.
"What is happening!?"
He repeated his question, this time, his voice was even louder.
"L-Lord Rajag!"
A Sovereign rushed in, his voice shivering.
Rajag turned towards him, and he continued,

"Zendel’s temperature is falling to an absurd degree, but this isn’t natural. The cultivators would be able to resist if it was natural, but this cold is accompanied by a cultivator’s energy, and anyone under the Sovereign Stage is unable to resist it.
From the quality of energy, it seems like the work of a Sovereign." Your next chapter awaits on freewebnovel
"A Sovereign?"
Rajag couldn’t believe what he was hearing.
"Y-Yes."
"Does that even make sense?"
"I-I am not s-sure."
The being replied. Now, even his body had started shivering. He could feel that his organs had started giving in.
"L-Lord R-R-Rajag…"
Rajag understood what was going on.
"Stay here. I will deal with this on my own."
Saying those words, Rajag disappeared.

’A Human…?’

To think a Sovereign would have such a ridiculously high energy reserve, and to think the being was a human of all the races.
"Who are you?"

The intention behind his words couldn’t be clearer.
Yes, what this man did was unforgivable, but…
His energy reserves were impressive. If he could recruit him to his side, then…

"Do you think you are the only one who tried to recruit him? All of us have tried it, but it doesn’t look like he is putting us in his eyes."

Honestly, this wasn’t a bout between them and the Human. If it were, they would have already taken care of him.

BOOOOOOOOOOM

chapters.title: Chapter 1879: This is the end.
paragraphs: "How about I show you what real Aura looks like?"

Nux grinned like a demon as his body started floating in the air. The Primordials around him rushed towards him, trying to grab him. He, however, ignored them all. His eyes continued to stare at the Transcendent hovering in the air above him.
He was a Velythari, also known as the Shattered Kin.

A race where one’s entire body consists of several floating shards that hovered around their core, constantly shifting and rearranging as they moved. Their bodies did not have a single fixed shape. They continued to alter their form by reconfiguring their shards as they adapted to their surroundings.
And the Transcendent who hovered above Nux was the Leader of the Velythari, Zyreth Ulmora.
*Picture*

By now, Nux had encountered countless Velythari. Well, he didn’t actually encounter them; he simply froze them before they could even understand what was happening. However, he did face a few Velythari Primordials and now knew quite a bit about these beings.
They were definitely interesting. It was difficult to kill them because even if he did destroy their body, they simply reformed again.
Even if he tried to target their core, their entire body would restructure in a way that protected the core, making it such that he needed to destroy everything in order to get to the core.

What was worse was the fact that this reconstruction was done almost instantly. Even if he took them by surprise, their body would react and reconstruct, making it difficult for him to actually kill them.
Honestly, out of all the races he had encountered in Zendel, this was definitely the most troublesome one.
And to think the first Transcendent he would encounter would be a Velythari.

Zyreth observed Nux in silence. Even though it was clear that Nux was about to do something, Zyreth didn’t seem particularly bothered by it. Rather, it seemed like he was looking forward to what he was about to show.
Yes, Zyreth was treating Nux as a circus monkey, a means for entertainment.
And Nux, who could see that, just grinned even more.
He would make sure this being enjoyed the show he was so much looking forward to.
BOOOOOOOOOOM
Nux’s Aura burst out.
The Aura of an independent universe burst out.
And in an instant, everything… collapsed.

The Primordials who tried to get close to Nux were instantly crushed onto the ground. The ones who were closest to him burst into pieces, their blood, gore, and flesh stuck on the ground. They looked like rats that were attacked by a large hammer, their bodies splattered on the ground.
It was a disgusting sight that would make even the beings with the strongest stomachs vomit their guts out.
However, this was just the beginning.

While the Primordials who were close to Nux were all crushed to death, the ones who were farther away were on their knees, their bones—or whatever their bodies were made of—were all crushed, their body structure had collapsed.
Yes, they were in no condition to fight anymore.
Zendel itself wasn’t in good condition either.
The air here grew impossibly heavy. Zendel’s Will groaned under the pressure, instantly summoning all the Transcendent Leaders that were connected to it to this place.
Its ground shook. Any structure above the ground, be it man-made buildings, natural trees, or mountains, all crumbled into pieces, flat on the ground.
Large fissures tore through the ground. Even the very energy Zendel and its people thrived on was locked on the ground, unable to float in the environment anymore.
Yes, the damage was irreversible.
Nux’s presence alone had sent Zendel back to when it was formed.
No life form below the Primordial level survived. All the advancements made by Zendel’s people were crushed into dust.
It was a calamity.
The worst calamity in the history of Zendel, something that would take tens of thousands of years to recover from.
Yes, a Middle-Level World, that pretty much ruled this sector of the Universe, was pushed to the brink of extinction the moment Nux released his Aura.
This was simply how heavy the weight of a universe is.
And what was even more horrifying?
It was the fact that even now, Nux wasn’t using his full strength.
Well, more accurately, he couldn’t use his full strength even if he wanted to.
He was in an entirely different universe. The power he could use here was extremely limited because the Main Universe resisted his.
If that wasn’t the case…
Then the Transcendents who had survived would have suffered a fate similar to the Primordials who were close to Nux.
Splattered to the ground in the most disgusting manner possible.

Of course, even if that didn’t happen, it didn’t mean the Transcendents had it easy either. Every single one of them had fallen on the ground and was on their knees, unable to move their bodies because of the heavy pressure that had descended on them.

Yes, even Zyreth, who once hovered in the air, looking down at everyone under him, commanding an absolute presence, was now on the ground, on his knees, his body restructuring in a way that prevented its complete destruction.
"W-Who is that h-human…?"
One of the Transcendents questioned, his voice trembling as he was having difficulty speaking.
"I-Is this the e-end…?"
Another one questioned, his face pale in horror.
The destruction he saw, Zendel’s fear that he could sense, everything made his body shiver as fear rooted itself into his very being.
It didn’t matter if the quality of energy this being released before could only be compared to a Sovereign.
A Sovereign…?
What Sovereign could do… this?
Heck, let alone a Sovereign, what Transcendent could do this!?
This being… whoever or whatever he is… destroyed their entire world…
Everything they cherished, their families, their loved ones, this being destroyed everything.
Why…?
This question appeared in their minds, but none of them dared to ask.
No one other than Zyreth Ulmora.
BOOOM
Suddenly, another Aura burst out. It was Zyreth.
The Velythari tried to overpower Nux with his Aura, but…
"Don’t be foolish, Velythari.
Explore stories at freewebnovel
If your mere Aura could have stopped me, this never would have happened in the first place."
Nux slapped the Velythari’s Aura away.
"This is the end.
Accept it."

Accept it."

Everyone except one.
"It will be the end when I fall to my end."
Zyreth answered, and suddenly,
The sky trembled, and the very fabric of existence shuddered.
’I thought I would be able to intimidate him, but I guess he isn’t a Transcendent and a World Leader for nothing.’
Nux, who sensed what was about to happen, sighed weakly as he closed his eyes, giving in to his fate.
Nux was no longer a child who would barge into enemy territory without having any prior knowledge.

He had done his research before he came here. He found out everything there was to know about Zendel—the different races residing in it, its people, the strongest beings who stood as its pillars, its environment, the energy it used, the Primordials, the Transcendents—he found out every single thing.

Before coming here, this man had learned everything there was to learn about every single Primordial and Transcendent there was on Zendel—their Laws, their abilities, their race, the level of their bloodlines, their strengths, their weaknesses, their allies, their enemies.
He learned everything.
And after his thorough research, one of the few beings who constantly worried him was the Velythari Leader, Zyreth Ulmora.
Not only were his racial abilities quite strong, but what stood out the most was his Law.
The Law of Resurgence.
A Law that governs the cycle of dissolution and rebirth, not in a way tied to mere life and death, but as an eternal transformation of ’form’ and ’state.’

The Law of Resurgence pretty much turns Zyreth into an immortal. Using this Law, it became impossible to truly destroy Zyreth because, using his Law, Zyreth could never be destroyed—only restructured, remade, or redefined.
Every time he died, his very existence was rewritten, reassembling into something new.

And this wasn’t just true for Zyreth himself. He could use his Law on anyone or anything around him—a weapon, a soul, or even a Law itself. Anything that was disintegrated could be returned in a different form.
And the Law wasn’t just used to ’bring back.’
It also allowed Zyreth to dismantle anything—concepts, weapons, structures, or even… beings.
And force them to reconstruct in a way that suited his design. A being who was once an enemy could be turned into his most trusted subordinate, and this was just the start of it.
Zyreth had the power to recall entire civilizations in a way he wanted them to be.
Honestly, it was an absurd Law with so many possibilities that when Nux learned about it, the first thing that came to his mind was trying to find a way to get his hands on this Law.
For now, however, this wasn’t what worried him.
What worried him was the fact that Zyreth was a Transcendent.
His Law was already absurdly powerful, but…
Transcendents had something that made them so different from others around them, something that made them absolute.
A Domain.
A Transcendent is called as such because beings at this level have transcended the boundaries of understanding of their Law and have pushed themselves to Absolute Perfection.
Yes, ’Absolute’ Perfection.
A Transcendent Being, because of his Absolute understanding of his Law, could create a Domain where his Law was Absolute.
Yes, even a normal Law such as… the Law of Resurgence… inside Zyreth’s domain, turns into the Law of Absolute Resurgence.
A field where his already absurd powers would become Absolute.
This is what the Velythari was trying to create.
What’s worse?
Nux couldn’t stop him.

Beings who were wiped from history started taking form again.
The ground beneath changed as well, turning into a constantly reconstructing surface. Every step seemed to shatter it, and every next one reassembled into something new.
Nothing remained the same for more than a few moments.
Everything in this Domain was bound by a single Law.
The Law of Absolute Resurgence.
Nothing ended. Nothing remained the same.
Yes, in this Domain, Zyreth, even though he was still on the ground, kneeling, had turned into the Absolute.
His powers had turned into the Absolute.
And yes, in this situation, if he decided to ’dismantle’ Nux and ’reconstruct’ him into his loyal subordinate,
It would work.
Nux might have had a way to resist it before, but in here, when everything this being did was Absolute, he was helpless.
And Nux, who knew that, sighed again.
"Tsk, I wanted a grander exit, you know?"
He muttered.
Zyreth frowned at those words.
"Oh well, not everything goes according to your plans."
Nux shrugged as he tried to teleport out of Zyreth’s Domain.
Keyword being tried, because before he could do it, the Velythari changed the very ’concept’ of Teleportation, bringing Nux right in front of him instead.
Seeing that his power was working on this monster, the expressions of the rest of the Transcendents changed as well.
And Nux, who noticed that, sighed.
"This is getting more and more troublesome."
He muttered out loud.
Zyreth wasn’t the only problematic being here; there were a few others, and if they all decided to join their hands together, it would become even more problematic.
Not wanting to deal with all that hassle,
Nux decided to self-destruct.
But,
Nothing happened.
He glanced at the Velythari, and the being smiled.
"You should have already expected it."
Yes, he dismantled the concept of Self-Destruction.
"Well, you are right.
I did expect this."
Nux nodded as he gave in.
Seeing his reaction, Zyreth smiled, regaining some of his confidence.
"It didn’t matter if you did.
You cannot get out of this situation.
You are exceptionally strong, I admit.
But you were never strong enough to deal with me on your own."
Zyreth declared.
But at his words, Nux’s grin just widened.
"Who said I was the one who was going to take care of you?"
"Huh…?"
"I’ve brought help."
Saying those words, Nux pointed up, and the moment Zyreth glanced in the direction he was pointed at,
His eyes widened in horror.

"This is the end.

He had done his research before he came here.

He learned everything.

Not only were his racial abilities quite strong, but what stood out the most was his Law.

Nux tilted his head and questioned with a playful frown on his face.
"Huh…?"
"I’ve brought help."

His eyes widened in horror.
A massive shadow loomed over the entirety of Zendel, covering everything in darkness.
"W-What is happening…?"
One of the Transcendents stuttered. He was a being born with special eyes. Right now, however, his eyes were nothing more than a curse.
He was ’cursed’ with the ability to see it.
The End.
"Farik, what do you see?"
Zyreth questioned with a frown on his face.
Farik, however, didn’t say anything. His body continued to tremble, his wide eyes had started turning purple, as if they were strained by a force unknown to him.
"Farik!"
Zyreth yelled, trying to pull him out of his reverie. Farik, however, simply pointed at the sky with his trembling fingers, and only one phrase came out of his mouth.
"It’s over… It’s over… It’s over…"
Zyreth frowned at that behavior. He found it disgraceful and shameful.
But then,
RUMBLE RUMBLE RUMBLE
THUNDER THUNDER THUNDER

Zendel itself screamed in terror. This time, the terror it felt was far more primordial than when Nux released his Aura. The entire world shook violently. The cracks Nux had created on the ground widened even further.
"Zendel! What is happening!?"
Zyreth tried to communicate with Zendel’s Will.
However, the Will didn’t react to his words. Rather, a white ball appeared right in front of Nux.
It was a form of surrender.
Zendel was pleading.
It wanted everything to stop, even if it had to surrender itself in exchange.
Zyreth, who could clearly understand the meaning behind Zendel’s actions, turned towards Nux, his eyes enraged.
"What did you do!?"
Nux just smiled at those words.
"Did you forget what I said?
I brought help.
It’s an old acquaintance."
RUMBLE RUMBLE RUMBLE
THUNDER THUNDER THUNDER
As if reacting to those words, the Universe reacted even more strongly.
It finally found him!
The Anomaly!
Yes, the instant Nux released his Aura to its fullest extent, the Universe reacted. This time, however, it didn’t react how it normally would.
It waited.
It waited and surrounded the Anomaly with hundreds of asteroids, every single one of them a tenth of Zendel’s size. All of them attacking Zendel at the same time.
Yes, the Universe had decided to destroy the entirety of Zendel to make sure it got the Anomaly in the process.
And as if the time had come, the shadow that loomed over Zendel became darker and darker, and finally,
Zyreth and the others were able to see it.
Hundreds of monstrous asteroids, each the size of a continent, descending as if they were some form of divine punishment.
RUMBLE RUMBLE RUMBLE
THUNDER THUNDER THUNDER
Zendel screamed in fear. It could sense its end.

"I… I cannot teleport!"
One of the Transcendents admitted, his body trembling in absolute horror.
"I-I cannot do it either! None of my artifacts are working!"
Another one shouted.
Nux, however, just laughed at those words.
Teleport away?
From the Universe’s attack?
Did that even make sense?
The Universe was an Absolute Entity that commanded everything there was.
Let alone a mere Middle-Level World, even a Supreme World would be utterly helpless against it.
How was one even supposed to face such an entity?
Use their Laws?
How foolish.
Every Law in the Universe was connected to it. The Universe had the ability to cancel any Law, any Concept, at any place, and nothing would be able to stop it.
The first thing the Universe did when it decided to attack this place was erase the Concept of Teleportation.
Let alone those who were trying to use artifacts, even beings with Laws related to Teleportation, Absolute or not, wouldn’t be able to teleport away from here.
They were all stuck here. They could do nothing but wait for their impending doom.
"WHAT ARE YOU DOING!? IF THIS CONTINUES, YOU ARE GOING TO DIE WITH US!!"
One of the Transcendents screamed as he grabbed Nux by his neck, his face full of rage. Rage that was covering his fear.
Any being would be intimidated by the look this being had on his face,
Any but Nux.
"Don’t be foolish. I was prepared to die when I came here."
Nux then glanced at Zyreth and,
"Your friend here should know that, no?"
After all, Zyreth had decimated the concept of self-destruction using his domain to prevent Nux from doing that.
The Velythari clenched his fists in frustration.
Seeing that, Nux smiled and spoke with an assuring look on his face.
"Don’t worry, it will be a painless death, I promise."
At those words, the Transcendent snapped, unable to take it anymore.
"Painless!? Stop it this instant, or I will make you beg for a painless dea—"
"First of all."
Before he could even complete, Nux interrupted.
"That threat makes no sense at all.
Stop that?
Do you think I have the power to do that?
Pointy dude, look above you,"
Nux pointed up. Then, he stressed his next words,
"Do you really think I have control over those things?

Do you truly believe that I would be here babbling with you if I had that power? Especially when you are holding my neck like this? Trust me, the first thing I would have done if I had that sort of power was to kill you because of how you are grabbing me."
Nux spoke, and involuntarily, the Transcendent released him.
His body had given in to fear.
Nux, however, didn’t care and continued,
"Also, what could you even do? Torture me?"
His smile then turned demonic and,
"First of all, I highly doubt you can inflict more pain on me than what I have already been through.
And second,𝑓𝘳𝑒𝑒𝓌𝘦𝘣𝘯ℴ𝑣𝘦𝑙.𝘤𝑜𝑚
You don’t exactly have enough time."
Nux completed as he looked above. The asteroids were finally here. Their massive surface burned as they entered Zendel’s atmosphere. The flames scorched the very sky.
RUMBLE RUMBLE RUMBLE
THUNDER THUNDER THUNDER
Zendel trembled, and Zyreth, who could see his and his world’s impending doom,
"Warriors of Zendel."
He called out with a solemn look on his face.
"We will fight."

chapters.title: Chapter 1882: End.
paragraphs: "Warriors of Zendel,"
Zyreth called out, his eyes intently staring at the incoming asteroids.
"We will fight,"
he declared.
"Have you lost your mind!? How are we supposed to fight tha—"
"Then what do you plan to do? Wait for your death?"
Before the other Transcendent could complete his sentence, Zyreth turned towards him and questioned in a condescending tone.
"Gragor, you were always a coward who hid his true self behind his strength.
But for once, stand up and fight for yourself.
Find more adventures on freewebnovel
Fight for your pride."
Zyreth spoke in a cold tone. Then, he turned back towards the sky and,
"And if you cannot,
Then let others do it."
He spoke, and as Gragor looked around, he noticed that the rest of the Transcendents had prepared themselves, ready to stop their world’s doom against all odds.

Yes, some were hesitant, and almost all of them were afraid, but this didn’t stop them from standing up one last time, desperately fighting for that chance of survival, no matter how impossibly low it was.
Gragor’s body shook. Then, the look on his face changed as well.
He made a decision as well.
He would fight.
Just like the other Transcendents, he stood up and distanced himself from Zyreth.
Transcendents fought using their Domains. However, two Domains, unless they were of a similar nature, could not coexist in a single place.
Every time two Transcendents deployed their Domains, they clashed with each other, and the stronger Domain came out on top.
Right now, however, all of Zendel’s Transcendents distanced themselves in a way that their Domains wouldn’t clash with each other’s.
Yes, they would take on the asteroids separately.
"I didn’t think you would try and fight back.
What happened to torturing me?
I was looking forward to it, you know?
Not that I am an M, don’t misunderstand, I just wanted to see if you people had some inter—"
Before Nux could complete his words, he froze.
The Concept of Time around him was dismantled.
The last thing Zyreth wanted right now was an annoying distraction.
After dealing with Nux, the Velythari turned towards the sky again.
The sky itself was split apart. For the first time in his life, Zyreth was able to see outer space from his own world. It all felt like an illusion, but the Velythari knew it was very real.
Zyreth flew up, his mind racing, coming up with a way to protect or at least… survive.
For the first time in his long life, his power, his law, felt… meaningless.
But in the end, he raised his hand.
The air around him trembled. His Domain stretched outward, warping the sky with an unseen force.
And time itself tore open.
Thousands of Zyreths of different forms and shapes from thousands of different possibilities appeared beside him.
They all extended their hands towards the sky and,
"Resurgence Eternum."
Time reversed.
The falling asteroids shuddered, their trajectories distorted.
Reality itself twisted in protest.
The asteroids were actually returning,
Or so it seemed.
But…
As if mocking him,
The asteroids pushed forward.
The power of thousands of Zyreths was utterly helpless.
However, they didn’t give in. If they couldn’t reverse time,
They would destroy the incoming asteroids instead.
Reality warped again. The air turned into flames, prepared to reduce everything to ashes, but…
The moment the sea of fire met the burning asteroids, rather than reducing them to death, the flames seemed to have strengthened them instead.
Another failure.
The flames couldn’t burn the giant asteroids. These ’entities’ were simply too robust to be burned with little flames.
After the flames, Zyreth tried physical force. He tried to form a Force Barrier to slow down the asteroids’ advance, but…
Once again, nothing happened.
It seemed like everything Zyreth did was utterly useless.
He was simply wasting his energy reserves.
"Haaahh… Haaahh… Haaahh…."
Yes, Zyreth was exhausted.
One by one, his ’possibilities’ were being erased from this reality.
His Law, which allowed him to warp reality itself, was failing.
After all, how could it possibly resist the might of the very Universe?
It was all meaningless.
One by one, the asteroids came down and finally,
The first one landed.
BOOOOOOOOOM
The entire western continent ceased to exist.
There was no aftermath; it was simply gone.
The land, the already smashed buildings, the sky above it—all erased from the fabric of existence.
Zyreth’s body trembled.
In the end, he could only think of one thing.
He rose above. His crystal-like body became translucent, his core shining much more brightly than it ever had.
An absurdly large amount of energy was gathered, and suddenly,
BOOOOOOM
An absurdly strong force surrounded the incoming asteroids, trying to crush them into pieces, and,
Crack
This time, it worked.
At the very least, something happened…
A very small crack, barely visible on its surface, appeared on the asteroid closest to Zyreth.
The Velythari, who saw that, let out a weak chuckle.
’So that is all the difference my entire life could make, huh…’
He muttered in his head. He stared at his allies, wanting to see if any of them had managed to do something at their end. What he saw, however, made him close his now tired eyes.
His body continued to become more and more translucent before it disappeared from existence.
Yes, the Velythari was no more.
He couldn’t see his world fall apart in front of his own eyes, so he decided to leave first.
It would have been an emotional moment if there was anyone to witness it.
Well, there was.
Nux, who was now unfrozen since the Velythari was gone, saw the sight of hundreds of absurdly huge asteroids falling from the sky and felt his heart shudder.
Although he couldn’t see it himself, he could guess what the Velythari’s last moments were like.
"Haaahh…"
He exhaled deeply as he sat on the barren ground.
Then, the next asteroid fell. This time, another continent disappeared.
Then another,
And another,

Zyreth called out, his eyes intently staring at the incoming asteroids.
"We will fight,"
he declared.
"Have you lost your mind!?
How are we supposed to fight tha—"
"Then what do you plan to do?
Wait for your death?"
Before the other Transcendent could complete his sentence, Zyreth turned towards him and questioned in a condescending tone.
"Gragor, you were always a coward who hid his true self behind his strength.
But for once, stand up and fight for yourself.
Find more adventures on freewebnovel
Fight for your pride."
Zyreth spoke in a cold tone.
Then, he turned back towards the sky and,
"And if you cannot,
Then let others do it."
He spoke, and as Gragor looked around, he noticed that the rest of the Transcendents had prepared themselves, ready to stop their world’s doom against all odds.

Yes, some were hesitant, and almost all of them were afraid, but this didn’t stop them from standing up one last time, desperately fighting for that chance of survival, no matter how impossibly low it was.
Gragor’s body shook.
Then, the look on his face changed as well.
He made a decision as well.
He would fight.
Just like the other Transcendents, he stood up and distanced himself from Zyreth.
Transcendents fought using their Domains.
However, two Domains, unless they were of a similar nature, could not coexist in a single place.
Every time two Transcendents deployed their Domains, they clashed with each other, and the stronger Domain came out on top.
Right now, however, all of Zendel’s Transcendents distanced themselves in a way that their Domains wouldn’t clash with each other’s.
Yes, they would take on the asteroids separately.
"I didn’t think you would try and fight back.
What happened to torturing me?
I was looking forward to it, you know?
Not that I am an M, don’t misunderstand, I just wanted to see if you people had some inter—"
Before Nux could complete his words, he froze.
The Concept of Time around him was dismantled.
The last thing Zyreth wanted right now was an annoying distraction.
After dealing with Nux, the Velythari turned towards the sky again.
The sky itself was split apart.
For the first time in his life, Zyreth was able to see outer space from his own world.
It all felt like an illusion, but the Velythari knew it was very real.
Zyreth flew up, his mind racing, coming up with a way to protect or at least… survive.
For the first time in his long life, his power, his law, felt… meaningless.
But in the end, he raised his hand.
The air around him trembled.
His Domain stretched outward, warping the sky with an unseen force.
And time itself tore open.
Thousands of Zyreths of different forms and shapes from thousands of different possibilities appeared beside him.
They all extended their hands towards the sky and,
"Resurgence Eternum."
Time reversed.
The falling asteroids shuddered, their trajectories distorted.
Reality itself twisted in protest.
The asteroids were actually returning,
Or so it seemed.
But…
As if mocking him,
The asteroids pushed forward.
The power of thousands of Zyreths was utterly helpless.
However, they didn’t give in.
If they couldn’t reverse time,
They would destroy the incoming asteroids instead.
Reality warped again.
The air turned into flames, prepared to reduce everything to ashes, but…
The moment the sea of fire met the burning asteroids, rather than reducing them to death, the flames seemed to have strengthened them instead.
Another failure.
The flames couldn’t burn the giant asteroids.
These ’entities’ were simply too robust to be burned with little flames.
After the flames, Zyreth tried physical force.
He tried to form a Force Barrier to slow down the asteroids’ advance, but…
Once again, nothing happened.
It seemed like everything Zyreth did was utterly useless.
He was simply wasting his energy reserves.
"Haaahh…
Haaahh…
Haaahh…."
Yes, Zyreth was exhausted.
One by one, his ’possibilities’ were being erased from this reality.
His Law, which allowed him to warp reality itself, was failing.
After all, how could it possibly resist the might of the very Universe?
It was all meaningless.
One by one, the asteroids came down and finally,
The first one landed.
BOOOOOOOOOM
The entire western continent ceased to exist.
There was no aftermath; it was simply gone.
The land, the already smashed buildings, the sky above it—all erased from the fabric of existence.
Zyreth’s body trembled.
In the end, he could only think of one thing.
He rose above.
His crystal-like body became translucent, his core shining much more brightly than it ever had.
An absurdly large amount of energy was gathered, and suddenly,
BOOOOOOM
An absurdly strong force surrounded the incoming asteroids, trying to crush them into pieces, and,
Crack
This time, it worked.
At the very least, something happened…
A very small crack, barely visible on its surface, appeared on the asteroid closest to Zyreth.
The Velythari, who saw that, let out a weak chuckle.
’So that is all the difference my entire life could make, huh…’
He muttered in his head.
He stared at his allies, wanting to see if any of them had managed to do something at their end.
What he saw, however, made him close his now tired eyes.
His body continued to become more and more translucent before it disappeared from existence.
Yes, the Velythari was no more.
He couldn’t see his world fall apart in front of his own eyes, so he decided to leave first.
It would have been an emotional moment if there was anyone to witness it.
Well, there was.
Nux, who was now unfrozen since the Velythari was gone, saw the sight of hundreds of absurdly huge asteroids falling from the sky and felt his heart shudder.
Although he couldn’t see it himself, he could guess what the Velythari’s last moments were like.
"Haaahh…"
He exhaled deeply as he sat on the barren ground.
Then, the next asteroid fell.
This time, another continent disappeared.
Then another,
And another,
Until finally, the next asteroid fell right on top of where Nux stood, and Nux, who saw that sight, could only think of one thing…
’Holy shit…’

chapters.title: Chapter 1883: A Weapon Rather Than A Threat.
paragraphs: ’Holy shit…’
Nux thought inwardly as the large asteroid fell on top of his body, crushing the body and physical strength he was so proud of in that very instant.
Against the Universe’s Might, there was no resistance.
There was no ’Quality of Energy’ or any other factor included. What crushed Nux and eradicated him from existence was pure physical impact generated from his collision with the asteroid.
He was helpless, utterly helpless, as anyone would be.
Even if it were an Eternal Stage Cultivator, it would be the same.
After all, their biggest weapon that they relied on the entire time was rendered utterly useless.

Laws didn’t work against the Universe. Whether it was a Law that strengthened a being, a Law that enhanced their regeneration, a Law that stopped time itself, or the Law that could give them the power over Space,
The Universe could simply nullify all Laws, making them absolutely useless.

A Primordial, Transcendent, an Eternal, or even an Infinity, with their Laws nullified, every single one of them was helpless. The only thing they had going for them was their ’high-quality energy,’ and well…
Against an Asteroid that was big enough to be compared to a World, any quality of energy was nothing short of useless.
Not to mention there were hundreds of such asteroids attacking Zendel.
Yes, the Universe had gone all out.
Even if the one on the receiving end was the strongest being in existence, he wouldn’t survive.
The Universe made sure anyone and everyone would fall.
Well…
Everyone except Nux.
Other beings were helpless because their Laws, or their Domains, everything was connected to the Universe, giving it the power to nullify them, but Nux?
His Laws were never connected to the Universe in the first place,
So…
Even when he ’perished,’ it wasn’t the end.
Inside Core, the women stared at the white screen in front of them, their expressions unreadable.
It was the first time they had seen Transcendents in action.
Even Aeliana was the same.
Yes, she had trained with Progenitors most of her life and had even given them a run for their money, but…

The Progenitors were merely Pseudo Transcendents. Let alone a Domain, they didn’t even have a Law. Compared to true Transcendents like Zyreth, the Progenitors were like children who had barely learned how to walk.
Seeing the Domain for the first time in her life, Aeliana and all the other women present were mesmerized. A Domain where one was Absolute.
’So this is what it means to be a Transcendent.’
The women nodded.
They thought that nothing could surprise them anymore, but…
They soon realized how utterly wrong they were.
Honestly, almost all of them were expecting that the Universe would simply devour Zendel and be done with it…
But for it to take such extreme actions,
Actions that even a being like Zyreth became absolutely helpless against…
Honestly, the women couldn’t help but feel… small.
To think a being they all looked at in awe, the being that felt so… strong…
Enjoy new adventures from freewebnovel
Would fall in such a helpless manner.
Then what was the point?
Wouldn’t they be the same?
Would it even matter if they ever got stronger? After all, against the Universe, it would all be useless. They would never be able to help Nux.
However, before the women could follow through with that line of thought, something changed.
Zyreth had now fallen. The asteroid’s next target was now Nux, and instead of running away like they were expecting him to…
Nux simply sat down on the ground and stared at the sky in awe.
Through his eyes, the women saw that scene as well. They were overwhelmed. However, their worry for Nux overpowered everything else they felt.
Finally, the asteroid clashed with Nux’s body, and…
The screen they were staring at turned white.
No woman said anything.
They had just witnessed the death of the man they loved the most. Their hearts were shaken, and then suddenly,

Amaya’s shadow trembled, attracting all the women’s attention, and in a few seconds, Nux materialized from her shadow, stretching and cracking his body, as if getting used to the feeling of being alive again.
"That was… definitely much grander than I expected."
He admitted as he stared at the women with a bright smile on his face.
The women stared at him in silence, and maybe it was because his senses were duller than normal since he was just reborn, but Nux was completely oblivious to their looks and continued to speak.
"I was expecting it to use asteroids, but to think it would use so many at the same time. Zendel is completely crushed, nothing’s left there.

Also, I thought my body would have been able to hold on for a few seconds, but I perished the instant I came in contact with the asteroid. Honestly, I think that even if I was as strong as I am in my own Universe, it would have been the same.
Those asteroids were definitely something.
Honestly, that Universe is overdoing it. This is such a waste of resources, it’s no different than using a missile to kill a mosquito.
Ah right, you people won’t understand this, will you?
Well, you see, back in my world, since there was no magic, we created weapons of mass des—"
Nux would have continued with his story, but then,
"Nux."
Amaya called out, her eyes as cold as they could get.
"Why did you wait?"
She questioned directly.
"Hmm?"
Nux tilted his head in confusion.
"I am asking why you waited for the asteroids to attack you. Why didn’t you come here before that happened?"
Nux stared at his wife. Only now did he realize what was wrong.
His wives were worried…
He honestly wanted to lie right now. However, he didn’t have complete control over his emotions yet, so he knew the wives who could sense his emotions would immediately catch his lie.
So in the end,
He decided to say the truth.
"I wanted to see if I could survive if I went against the Universe or not."
The women turned silent at that answer, and Nux just scratched the back of his head with an awkward smile on his face.
"Turns out I cannot. I am nowhere strong enough."
Again, the women stayed silent, all of them staring at Nux with expressionless looks on their faces.
Seeing that, Nux sighed.
"I am fine, okay? I knew what I was doing."
He assured them with a serious look on his face.
"What if something happened to you?"
Amaya questioned.
"I cannot die as long as you are alive, remember?"
"That Transcendent stopped you from self-destructing."
Amaya replied, her eyes staring at Nux, demanding answers.

"He was able to dismantle the concept of self-destruction, he was even able to freeze time around you, and when you stood against him, you also realized that if he wanted, he could turn you into his puppet with no free will. He could have even dismantled your existence, and you would have ceased to exist, even stopping your rebirth.
That Transcendent could do it all, and there was nothing you could have done against it.
Then why couldn’t the Universe do the same?
How were you so sure that the Universe wouldn’t be able to hurt you?"
Amaya questioned, her voice trembling continuously.
She was shaken. Nux’s death had a much stronger effect on her than she expected, especially when she considered the possibility of him never returning to her.
Just the thought of a life without Nux pushed her to the deepest pits of despair, and it wasn’t just her. The rest of the women present here, even Aeliana, felt the same.
Nux, who could sense their shaken emotions, slowed down and answered,
"Because the Universe is helpless against me."
He answered.
The women narrowed their eyes, and he continued,
"I realized it when I was there.
Yes, against a Transcendent, I am at risk of truly losing my life, but that isn’t the case against the Universe.
To truly kill me, one needs an Absolute Law and a Quality of Energy that is higher than mine.
The Universe, however, could only hurt me using brute force. It has no ’quality of energy.’ Its tricks are useless against me.

Even when it erased the concept of teleportation to prevent everyone from running away, the concept it erased belonged to its area of influence. I, who do not come under its influence, was not limited by it."
"So… you could have teleported away from that situation the whole time…?"
Vyriana questioned with a ridiculous look on her face.
"If Zyreth wasn’t stopping me, yes.
This is also how I realized that all my abilities work even when the Universe tries to restrict them. So even if I died by its attack, because of Lane’s Law, I cannot truly die."
Nux nodded.
"But… how…?"
The Dragon couldn’t understand.
"As I said, the Universe is helpless against me. It has no clue how to deal with an existence like me.
Even now, when I am here, it cannot sense me because I am not releasing my Aura anymore."
"Is it because the Universe is a Will and not a living entity?"
Felberta questioned. As a being with powers related to creation, she could comprehend this concept better than the others.
Nux nodded at her words.
"That is correct.
It is similar to how Umbrasol’s Will could protect itself from an Eternal Level Being but was absolutely helpless against someone like me, who is much weaker.
Yes, the Universe is an entity with Absolute Power,
But with its limited knowledge, it cannot do anything against me.
It is more of a weapon I can use to my advantage than a threat."

paragraphs: "Yes, the Universe is an entity with Absolute Power,
But with its limited knowledge, it cannot do anything against me.
It is more of a weapon I can use to my advantage than a threat."
Nux declared confidently, and once again, the women stared at him in silence.
This time, however, their silence didn’t come from their worry; it came from the absurdity of his statement.
"…doesn’t this mean you can even destroy a Supreme World using the Universe?"
Felberta questioned.
Just the thought of that felt absurd. She even wondered what would happen if they destroyed all Four Supreme Worlds.
The entire Universe would fall into chaos as hundreds of High Level Worlds would fight for new Supremacy, yes, but…
Isn’t chaos where they thrived the most?
Not to mention, this would allow them to get rid of the biggest threat they faced, and with Azriel’s protection, nothing could possibly stop them.

They could go around doing whatever they wanted, attract whatever attention they wanted to attract, and once something wrong happened and they faced an attack they were unable to deal with, they could simply return to Yrniel, and the Vampire Father would take up and deal with the problem.
They could even declare Yrniel to be a new and only Supreme World, have Supreme Power, and create an environment where Nux could grow safely.
The more Felberta thought about it, the better the idea felt.

It wasn’t just her; the other women who heard her words began to think along the same lines. Their eyes brightened as they came to the same conclusion. They stared at Nux, but the latter shook his head and laughed out loud.
"Don’t you remember your father telling me not to get in contact with the Supreme Worlds?"
He chuckled.
"You… are going to listen to him?"
Astaria raised her eyebrows.
This was Nux they were talking about. When had this man listened to… anyone?
Astaria knew that even if he might not do it for his own sake, if there was a possibility that he could ensure a safe environment for his wives, Nux would do it.
Backing down just because someone told him to…
It wasn’t very… Nux-like.
"I am."
Nux, however, nodded his head.
He saw an Infinity in action once when he was reading Umbrasol’s memories, and one thing he learned about them… was to never underestimate them.

From Umbrasol’s memories, Nux knew everything there was to know about Transcendents and Middle-Level Worlds. He knew what challenges he could encounter and had thought of a way to get out of trouble if he got into one.
But… against a Supreme World?
A blank field he had no information about?
"Let alone a Supreme-Level World, I can’t even use this method against a High-Level World."
Nux shook his head.
"Why is that?"
"Eternals."
Nux answered.
He stared at his women and,

"In their Domains, Eternals are similar to Gods. Beings capable of wrapping reality in its truest form. With just their mere thought, I would turn into a burst of memories for them to read and understand what I am,
And once they do…"
"They will understand who the Anomaly is and offer them to the Universe."
Aeliana completed the sentence.
At least, that is what she would do.
"Correct."
Nux nodded.
"And unlike the Universe, they will make sure I truly perish."
Nux then thought about it a little more, then came to a conclusion,

"If I use everything in my power and consider the element of surprise, I can probably take out one High Level World, but if they are even half as capable as the beings in Umbrasol were, the information regarding me would spread.
The rest of the High Level Worlds would never fall for the same trick, and honestly, that wouldn’t even be our worst problem."
Nux stared at his women and,𝗳𝐫𝚎𝗲𝚠𝚎𝗯𝕟𝐨𝘃𝚎𝗹.𝗰𝗼𝗺
"It would be the Supreme Worlds.
Once the information is released, the Supreme Worlds would realize that I am the Anomaly the Universe is after, and they will definitely come after me."
"To offer you to the Universe?"
Evane questioned, but Nux shrugged.
"How would I know what they intend to do? Offer me, study me, or anything else they might have in their sick heads,
But I do know one thing,
That is, we are not going to survive, even if we decide to hide in our Universe."
Nux declared with a solemn look on his face, and the women turned silent.
Seeing their expressions, Nux just chuckled, and then,
"And these are just the consequences of me attacking a mere High-Level World.
As for the Supreme Worlds…
Let’s not even think about it, shall we?"
The women nodded, quickly getting rid of whatever thoughts they had in their minds.
Honestly, right now, they wanted nothing more than to read Nux’s mind and learn everything he knew.
With the knowledge he possessed, they would probably be able to come up with a much better plan and not suggest something foolish every time they spoke.
Of course, Nux wanted to share what he knew as well, but…
Their minds simply wouldn’t be able to comprehend it, not even Aeliana’s.
"So… this means that your ’Weapon’ is limited to Middle-Level Worlds?"

"You were busy investigating the five Middle-Level Worlds you are going to attack, trying to see if something or someone might hinder your plan?"
Thyra guessed.

"Wrong.
I was busy investigating three hundred and sixty-six worlds I am going to attack."
