This time, however, their silence didn’t come from their worry; it came from the absurdity of his statement.
"…doesn’t this mean you can even destroy a Supreme World using the Universe?"
Felberta questioned.
Just the thought of that felt absurd.
She even wondered what would happen if they destroyed all Four Supreme Worlds.
The entire Universe would fall into chaos as hundreds of High Level Worlds would fight for new Supremacy, yes, but…
Isn’t chaos where they thrived the most?
Not to mention, this would allow them to get rid of the biggest threat they faced, and with Azriel’s protection, nothing could possibly stop them.

They could go around doing whatever they wanted, attract whatever attention they wanted to attract, and once something wrong happened and they faced an attack they were unable to deal with, they could simply return to Yrniel, and the Vampire Father would take up and deal with the problem.
They could even declare Yrniel to be a new and only Supreme World, have Supreme Power, and create an environment where Nux could grow safely.
The more Felberta thought about it, the better the idea felt.
It wasn’t just her; the other women who heard her words began to think along the same lines.
Their eyes brightened as they came to the same conclusion.
They stared at Nux, but the latter shook his head and laughed out loud.
"Don’t you remember your father telling me not to get in contact with the Supreme Worlds?"
He chuckled.
"You… are going to listen to him?"
Astaria raised her eyebrows.
This was Nux they were talking about.
When had this man listened to… anyone?
Astaria knew that even if he might not do it for his own sake, if there was a possibility that he could ensure a safe environment for his wives, Nux would do it.
Backing down just because someone told him to…
It wasn’t very…
Nux-like.
"I am."
Nux, however, nodded his head.
He saw an Infinity in action once when he was reading Umbrasol’s memories, and one thing he learned about them… was to never underestimate them.
From Umbrasol’s memories, Nux knew everything there was to know about Transcendents and Middle-Level Worlds.
He knew what challenges he could encounter and had thought of a way to get out of trouble if he got into one.
But… against a Supreme World?
A blank field he had no information about?
"Let alone a Supreme-Level World, I can’t even use this method against a High-Level World."
Nux shook his head.
"Why is that?"
"Eternals."
Nux answered.
He stared at his women and,
"In their Domains, Eternals are similar to Gods.
Beings capable of wrapping reality in its truest form.
With just their mere thought, I would turn into a burst of memories for them to read and understand what I am,
And once they do…"
"They will understand who the Anomaly is and offer them to the Universe."
Aeliana completed the sentence.
At least, that is what she would do.
"Correct."
Nux nodded.
"And unlike the Universe, they will make sure I truly perish."
Nux then thought about it a little more, then came to a conclusion,

"If I use everything in my power and consider the element of surprise, I can probably take out one High Level World, but if they are even half as capable as the beings in Umbrasol were, the information regarding me would spread.
The rest of the High Level Worlds would never fall for the same trick, and honestly, that wouldn’t even be our worst problem."
Nux stared at his women and,𝗳𝐫𝚎𝗲𝚠𝚎𝗯𝕟𝐨𝘃𝚎𝗹.𝗰𝗼𝗺
"It would be the Supreme Worlds.
Once the information is released, the Supreme Worlds would realize that I am the Anomaly the Universe is after, and they will definitely come after me."
"To offer you to the Universe?"
Evane questioned, but Nux shrugged.
"How would I know what they intend to do?
Offer me, study me, or anything else they might have in their sick heads,
But I do know one thing,
That is, we are not going to survive, even if we decide to hide in our Universe."
Nux declared with a solemn look on his face, and the women turned silent.
Seeing their expressions, Nux just chuckled, and then,
"And these are just the consequences of me attacking a mere High-Level World.
As for the Supreme Worlds…
Let’s not even think about it, shall we?"
The women nodded, quickly getting rid of whatever thoughts they had in their minds.
Honestly, right now, they wanted nothing more than to read Nux’s mind and learn everything he knew.
With the knowledge he possessed, they would probably be able to come up with a much better plan and not suggest something foolish every time they spoke.
Of course, Nux wanted to share what he knew as well, but…
Their minds simply wouldn’t be able to comprehend it, not even Aeliana’s.
"So… this means that your ’Weapon’ is limited to Middle-Level Worlds?"
Your journey continues at freewebnovel
Thyra questioned, and at her words, Nux shook his head again.
"No, even attacking a Middle-Level World is risky.
I need to make sure I do not meet a troublesome entity while I attack.
Beings with complicated Laws that could help release the information are off-limits.
I need to be very careful while I choose what Worlds I will attack.
Why do you think I waited for a month before I actually started attacking?"
"You were busy investigating the five Middle-Level Worlds you are going to attack, trying to see if something or someone might hinder your plan?"
Thyra guessed.
Nux, however, smiled at those words and,
"Wrong.
I was busy investigating three hundred and sixty-six worlds I am going to attack."
"Huh…?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1885: Challenging the Universe.
paragraphs: "Wrong.
I was busy investigating three hundred and sixty-six worlds I am going to attack."
Nux revealed, and the women blinked in surprise.
"Wait...
So when you told all of us to cultivate because this is going to take time..."
Nux turned towards Amaya and,
"Yeah, I was investigating all those worlds."
"But why so man-"
Amaya wanted to question. Soon, however, her expression changed as she realized it.
"If the Anomaly continues to appear in just this Sector alone, the Universe will destroy the entire Sector."𝚏𝕣𝕖𝚎𝚠𝚎𝚋𝚗𝐨𝐯𝕖𝕝.𝕔𝐨𝕞
Nux nodded.
"But wouldn’t that still attract attention towards this Sector? This is the previous problem all over again."
Aeliana muttered.
"It is not."
Amaya, however, shook her head.
"In the previous scenario, the Universe couldn’t detect the Anomaly, so the chances it would increase the area of impact to make sure it gets the Anomaly are higher.
Right now, however, since it knew exactly where the Anomaly was, senseless destruction didn’t make sense."
And once again, Nux nodded at his Yandere’s words.

"It is similar to how one would try to destroy the entire bridge to make sure that an invisible enemy falls, but if that enemy is visible and can be attacked, there is no point in destroying the bridge, even if it can be built again."
The rest of the women nodded at those words. Aeliana, however, didn’t seem satisfied.
"But even if you attack more worlds, if five worlds from this sector are destroyed, it will attract a lot of attention."
As if he was already expecting her to say these words, Nux smiled, and then, with a wave of his hand, he materialized a black screen.
"What is it?"
Aeliana questioned.
"Think of it as the Universe.
Of course, since the Universe is infinite, it is a very small part of the Universe."
Nux clarified.
Then, with a wave of his hand, a tiny ball appeared on the screen he had just created.
"This is Yrniel."
The women nodded at those words, and more and more ’worlds’ started appearing in the Universe.
"These are the worlds around Yrniel."
Then, five more worlds, slightly bigger than others, appeared.
"These are the Middle-Level Worlds we are targeting."
The women stared at the screen intently, trying to understand what Nux was trying to say. Then, suddenly, thousands of ’worlds’ appeared on the screen.
"These are the rest of the worlds around us."
"Is this our Sector?"
Aeliana questioned.
Nux, however, shook his head, and a circle formed, barely covering any area in the Universe.
"This is our Sector. It is a very small part of what we are dealing with."
"So what is the plan?"
Aeliana questioned, and suddenly, three hundred and sixty-six worlds were highlighted in the Universe Nux had created.
"So these are the worlds we aim to destroy."
Aeliana understood quickly. Soon, however, her expression changed.
"Wait...
They..."
The 366 worlds...
They formed a specific pattern.
It was...
"A Smirk?"
Evane muttered, and the instant she did, Nux’s smile widened.
"Exactly."
Aeliana’s expression changed.
"You are laughing at the Universe!"
"I am."
Nux laughed, his grin getting more and more mischievous.
"You are making a fool out of the Universe in front of every single world.
This...
Even if Supreme Worlds tried to investigate this case, they would only see it as the Anomaly openly challenging the Universe’s authority.
They wouldn’t even care about the Middle-Level Worlds that were destroyed in the process."
"Exactly."
Nux nodded, and Aeliana stared at Nux as if she were looking at an entirely different man.
"Nux, you...
You are a genius."
"Yes, I have heard that before.
But I still prefer words like ’handsome,’ ’prince charming,’ ’smoking hot.’"
Then, Nux glanced at the Vampire and,
"Of course, you can also use words like ’I Love You,’ that’s what I prefer the most."
Aeliana turned silent, not knowing what to say. Her pale face, however, had turned a bit red as she looked away.
Nux chuckled at that reaction. Then, thinking that he had enough rest, he prepared to leave again.
"Wait for me.
I’ll be back soon."
The women nodded as Nux disappeared, teleporting to the second world in another Sector.

The women then turned towards the screen that showed Nux’s vision. Of course, the 366 worlds he chose weren’t all Middle-Level Worlds. This one was the Lowest-Level World, with the strongest here being a Sovereign. Nux simply slapped the poor guy to death.
BOOOOM
He released his Aura, and the World’s Will quickly gave in. Nux stood still with the World’s Core in his hand, and finally...
RUMBLE RUMBLE RUMBLE
THUNDER THUNDER THUNDER
The Universe reacted, enraged again.
It had thought that it had finally gotten rid of the troublesome entity. However, it seemed like it was wrong.
No matter.
It would do the same thing again.
Once again, asteroids gathered around the Lowest-Level World, but then...
"Too Late."

Nux chuckled as he quickly devoured the World’s Core. With his brain now enhanced to such a level, the information he received didn’t even make him flinch, and without waiting anymore, Nux teleported to another world and released his Aura again.
RUMBLE RUMBLE RUMBLE
THUNDER THUNDER THUNDER
Enraged, the Universe reacted again. This time, without wasting any time, it attacked the world he was in with whatever asteroids it had lying around. The world was crushed together with the Anomaly.
Or so the Universe thought...

BOOOM
The Anomaly released its Aura again.
RUMBLE RUMBLE RUMBLE
THUNDER THUNDER THUNDER
And the Universe reacted again...
Then again...
And then again...
"I... feel bad for the Universe..."
On the other side, Allura, who stood on the ground that shook again every minute or two later, commented with a wry smile on her face.
"Every time the ground shakes...
A world is perishing."
Evane muttered, feeling complicated.
The rest of the women were the same. Even if they didn’t mind killing if it fulfilled their goals, this time... the death toll was in the hundreds of millions.
"He would let the entire Universe burn for our sake."
Amaya muttered, her eyes darker than ever before as her mind raced.
She would do the same.
"But he is not doing this for us..."
Aisha muttered. Clearly, she still didn’t like that Fox. At her words, however...
Eisheth chuckled.
"He isn’t doing this for that Fox."
"What...?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1886: Meeting.
paragraphs: Inside an ethereal hall, different beings sat on their respective thrones. Some thrones were grander than the others, while some seemed similar.

A peculiar thing to note was that in this hall, everything—the walls, the floor, the ceiling, the decorations, and even the thrones—seemed to have been made from the same white, translucent material, giving it a magical feel.
It looked as if everything here didn’t even exist in reality.
And that was correct.
This entire hall was a formless creation, made using the Laws of Time and Space. As for the beings here, all of them were mere projections.
This was the way the Crimson Covenant Faction held its meeting, with every being sending his or her projection to this otherworldly hall, where the agendas were discussed, and decisions were made.

At the highest point, there were five thrones, much more luxurious and detailed than any other thrones here. On those five thrones, there sat five beings, all representing their respective Lower Level Worlds.
Yes, Lower Level Worlds.
Normally, these thrones were reserved for beings from Middle Level Worlds that led the Crimson Covenant Faction. However…
The five worlds leading the Faction were…
…destroyed.
No one knew what or how it happened. The Faction just suddenly lost all communication with the five worlds, and when the scouts were sent to see what was happening, they only saw a void.
The worlds that were once there… weren’t anymore…
And this was also the reason this meeting was called.
"Then… what is the final decision?"
A being sitting on one of the highest thrones questioned with a grim look on his face.
"Surrender."
"Surrender."
"Surrender."
"Surrender."
The other four beings sitting on the other four thrones all had the same answer.
It wasn’t just them; the rest of the beings sitting on the thrones below nodded as well. Not a single being here had a different opinion.

After all, the enemy faction was simply too powerful. After all, how could they possibly face six Middle Level Worlds on their own when the strongest worlds on their side were somehow destroyed without a trace?
The moment the enemy faction found out about the disappearance of those worlds, they would come for them.
They were helpless. Even one of those six worlds could destroy their entire faction. There was no point in showing resistance.
Yes, there was an option to seek help outside the Sector, but…
Even that felt useless.
After all, that would only attract foreign attention to their Sector, something none of them wanted.
Surrendering was much better than resisting foolishly. Honestly, for most worlds, the only difference it would even make was that they would now be paying tribute to different worlds than before.
Of course, this didn’t mean it was the same for every single world. For some Lower Level Worlds, it was different.

In the Crimson Covenant Faction, there weren’t just five Lower Level Worlds—there were quite a few. The five Lower Worlds sitting at the top weren’t there because they were the strongest. No, they were there because they were closest to the Middle Level Worlds that ruled the Faction before.𝕗𝐫𝚎𝗲𝘄𝐞𝕓𝐧𝕠𝘃𝕖𝐥.𝐜𝚘𝚖
These worlds stood above the rest because the Middle Level Worlds gave them the power to control and manage the rest of us.
It was similar to how Sylveris had power over the Foxes’ lives. Now, however, that wasn’t the case anymore. With the Middle Level Worlds gone, the power of the ’Mark’ was gone.
The Foxes, together with the rest of the worlds, were now free.
And now…

Now that there would be new rulers, things would be different. The rest of the Lower Level Worlds now had the chance to get ahead and form a closer connection with the new rulers so they could stand below one and above the rest.
This was exactly what every representative of the Lower Level Worlds was thinking, and the representatives of the five Lower Level Worlds knew that as well.
Enjoy exclusive chapters from freewebnovel
Right now, no one here could be trusted since there was no power to lead them.
"The meeting’s dismissed."

One of the beings sitting on the five thrones spoke as he then turned towards a certain fox and nodded. The fox nodded back, and with a flick of her finger, everyone was sent back to their respective worlds.
Even the representative of Sylveris.
"Tsk."
He snorted in his head as he realized what happened.
He wanted the fox to send everyone but him and her because he still wanted to talk to her. But seeing how she blatantly ignored his signal made him tremble in anger.
"That bitch."
He cursed.
"Let it go, Aghaast. We already expected it."
Another being appeared beside him and spoke with a calm look on his face.
"Rather than them, focus on what we are going to do now. We need to offer them something that would attract their attention—something different from the others."
The being spoke in a solemn tone.
"What if… we reveal the existence of the Secret Weapon?"
Aghaast spoke after some consideration.

"Have you lost your mind? Even the previous worlds couldn’t get their hands on that weapon. Don’t forget, even a party led by a Transcendent was killed, and we still do not have any information regarding it.
Not to mention, the only link we had to get to that weapon is now broken since we no longer have a way to control the Foxes.
The Foxes are finally free. I highly doubt they would make the same mistake of going against a world that has a way to kill a Transcendent.
They will probably surrender to the Leaders of Yrniel, and this time, they will stay loyal to their world.
At least, that is what I would have done.

If we reveal the existence of the Secret Weapon to those worlds and they do something about it, it won’t take long for the Foxes to tell on us and for the Yrniel Progenitors to use that weapon against us.
Trust me, those Foxes would be dying for this opportunity after generations of suppression.
I see it in their eyes—they seek revenge."
"Then… what do we do…?"
"We need to talk to the Leaders of Yrniel.
We need to form a truce. I doubt even they would want new worlds to know about their Secret Weapon and attract pointless attention, so we will use that to our advantage."

They will probably surrender to the Leaders of Yrniel, and this time, they will stay loyal to their world.
At least, that is what I would have done.

If we reveal the existence of the Secret Weapon to those worlds and they do something about it, it won’t take long for the Foxes to tell on us and for the Yrniel Progenitors to use that weapon against us.
Trust me, those Foxes would be dying for this opportunity after generations of suppression.
I see it in their eyes—they seek revenge."
"Then… what do we do…?"
"We need to talk to the Leaders of Yrniel.
We need to form a truce.
I doubt even they would want new worlds to know about their Secret Weapon and attract pointless attention, so we will use that to our advantage."

chapters.title: Chapter 1887: We are free!
paragraphs: While Sylveris’ leaders were discussing their possible way out, the Foxes, who had returned to Yrniel, were doing the same.
"I can’t believe it."
One of the three Primordial Foxes, Aerion Dawnshade, spoke with a solemn look on his face.
These three were the true leaders of the Black Order and the Dawnshade House, hidden Primordials who continued to carry their house’s responsibility.
"To think Middle-Level Worlds will be destroyed without anyone finding out how… This is ridiculous."
Lysander, another one of them, nodded.
"What do you think of the Faction’s decision?"
Alzar, the third Primordial, questioned.
"What is there to think about? It is not like they have any other choice."
Aerion shrugged.
Enjoy new chapters from freewebnovel
"But this puts us in a difficult spot."
Alzar spoke with a solemn look on his face, and at his words, the other two leaders’ faces turned grim as well.
"I think it is time we put an end to this farce."
After a minute-long silence, Lysander spoke up.
The other two turned towards him, and he continued,
"This all started because our ancestors couldn’t accept becoming part of a Lower-Level World and cursed us with generations of slavery because of their foolish actions.
Now, however, we have the chance to change it all."
Lysander looked at the two leaders and,
"Yrniel’s leaders have been nothing but accepting towards us. No matter how much we say that they have been using us as a grindstone to strengthen their younger generation, the fact of the matter is,
They have always tried to be welcoming to us despite knowing we were traitors. They even let our people infiltrate the order so the people in Yrniel do not see us as outsiders.
They have done quite a lot for us, and all this while, we have been nothing but ungrateful.
Yes, it was partially because we were being threatened, but now that the threat is gone… It is time we come out clean and side with a world that has always accepted us, our home, Yrniel."
The other two leaders nodded.
It was indeed time to put an end to this farce.
Lysander then turned towards another person in the room and questioned,
"What do you think, Faelara?"
Faelara was one of the best of her generation, someone who they all knew would one day become a Primordial. They wanted to know her opinion and involve her in their decision.
"The three of you know best. I would never go against your decision."
Faelara answered respectfully.
"That is not what we are asking, Faelara. I want to know your opinion. What would you have done if we didn’t exist?"
"Please do not say such things, Lord Lysander. You three still need to lead us."
Faelara shook her head.
Then, she stared at the three leaders and,
"As to answer your question,
I would do the same thing.
What we need right now is a force that can protect our people and…
Someone has convinced me that Yrniel and its Progenitors are that force, a force that is strong enough to protect us as long as we remain loyal to them."
"Someone convinced you, huh…"
Lysander smiled as he stared at the woman in front of him.
"I wonder who this someone is."
He teased, and a light smile appeared on Faelara’s face.
"He is quite a bold one, I can tell you that."
"I do not doubt you. I have heard he has barged in here quite a lot of times."
"He has."
Faelara nodded.
"Why didn’t you report it to me?"
"I knew you already knew."
"Always so perceptive, eh?"
Faelara just smiled.
"Are you sure Yrniel can protect us?"
Lysander questioned, his expression turning solemn again.
"I am."
Faelara nodded.
"What if something happens?"
"Then I will be proven wrong."
"Can you burden the responsibility of a wrong decision like this one?"
Faelara turned silent. She stared at Lysander and the others, who were looking at her with light smiles on their faces. Clearly, they were testing her.
Preparing her to become the next True Leader, just like them.

"Yrniel stood strong even when five Middle-Level Worlds were after its secret weapon. It has already proven its strength. If I had to choose, I would try my luck under the shade of the tree that stood tall after the test of time."
"And what if Yrniel doesn’t accept us?"
"That I can assure you it will."
Faelara nodded confidently, and Lysander grinned.
"You really trust that boy, don’t you?"
Faelara just smiled.
"Quite different from that Emmett."
"Please do not mention that name. I was foolish back then."
"But to think you would kill your daughter’s father with your own hand."
"I do not accept incompetence."
Faelara spoke, her eyes turning cold.
Lysander stared at the woman for a while, his grin didn’t fade away.
"Alright then, we will go with what you suggest. I hope you are right about that boy and weren’t foolish this time."
"I am not. You can take my word for it."
Faelara smiled as she then bowed her head.
"I will take my leave then."
The leaders nodded, and Faelara activated her Law and returned to her room.
She lay comfortably on her bed and laughed out loud,
"It’s funny how he tries to act like he is on my side every time Emmett is mentioned.
To think he still doesn’t know that I know he was his son."
Faelara’s eyes turned cold, and,
"He really thought I wouldn’t notice if he planted a spy close to me, huh? As one would expect from a narrow-minded old fool."

The Fox chuckled, laughing as she recalled the time when she killed that man right in front of his father on the grounds of him being incompetent, and the only thing Lysander could do was clench his fists in anger, unable to protect his son despite being stronger than the murderer.
Knock Knock
While Faelara was grinning about it, she heard a knock.
"Mother, it is me."
Vulpiana spoke, and a gentle smile appeared on Faelara’s face.
"Come in."
The moment she said those words, the doors burst open, and Vulpiana jumped on top of her mother on the bed.
"We are free!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1888: It is definitely Nux!
paragraphs: "We are free!"
Vulpiana jumped on top of her mother and buried her face in her breasts. Faelara chuckled as she ruffled her daughter’s hair.
"We finally are free, huh?"
Faelara chuckled, still having a hard time believing it.
Vulpiana snuggled close to her mother. She truly felt liberated today. She had turned into a child who wanted to be spoiled.
And Faelara, knowing exactly what her daughter wanted, smiled and continued to ruffle her hair. She also rubbed her ears from time to time, making the daughter fox snuggle even closer to her.
Vulpiana enjoyed all the pampering and closed her eyes. Like a diligent mother, Faelara didn’t stop either. None of them said anything.
Both foxes seemed like they were lost in their own thoughts while they enjoyed each other’s presence.
And fifteen minutes later, Vulpiana, whose mind had finally calmed down, raised her hand and stared at her mother.
"Mother, he finally did it."
"Hmm?"
Faelara tilted her head, and the daughter fox continued.
"He promised he would save us, and he did. He saved not just us, but our entire race."
"Indeed."
Faelara nodded with a smile on her face.
Clearly, she was impressed.
"It is quite surprising.
To think he made him move."
Faelara nodded continuously as more and more theories appeared in her mind.
"To think he would make that man, who barely takes action, make a move when Yrniel was not even in danger…
It is quite surprising. He didn’t seem like a man who would give in so quickly, but I guess it makes sense.
His daughter is now with him.
If a father-in-law won’t help a son-in-law, who else would?"
Faelara chuckled.
Vulpiana, however, shook her head.
"You don’t understand!
He didn’t get anyone’s help!
He did it on his own!"
"Huh?"
Faelara’s expression changed.
"What do you mean?"
She narrowed her eyes.
"I am saying that Nux did it on his own! He destroyed those worlds on his own!"
Vulpiana answered, her eyes still shining brightly. Clearly, she couldn’t believe it, but she was so excited that she couldn’t care less about anything else.
Faelara, however, wasn’t the same.
"Don’t be ridiculous."
The Dawnshade Head frowned in confusion. It was the first time she seemed… truly shaken.
"That child is just a Sovereign. Even if he is much stronger than those at his level, taking on Middle-Level Worlds is just absurd.
Even if he has Aeliana supporting him, taking out even one, let alone five Middle-Level Worlds, was absolutely impossible.
Those worlds are protected by Transcendents.
No Sovereign or Primordial, no matter how strong, can even stand against a Transcendent, let alone kill him and destroy their world."
Faelara stated matter-of-factly.
Vulpiana, however, didn’t give in.
"No! The Universe reacted!
I am sure Nux was the one who did it!"
She was still adamant.
"The Universe reacted? What are you trying to say?"
Faelara blinked in confusion.
There were only two conclusions that lay in front of her: either her daughter had lost her mind, or…
She was extremely out of the loop here.
And for some reason, Faelara had a feeling that it was the latter.
"The Universe!
Did you not feel how Yrniel was trembling a few hours ago?"
"Yes, it was quite annoying."
Faelara snorted.
She had to use her Law to stabilize everything and prevent it from falling apart. Of course, this wasn’t the first time this had happened, so she was already used to it by now.
However, what made it even worse this time was the fact that it didn’t stop.
Usually, all the chaos stops after a few minutes, but this time,
Whenever it stopped and Faelara finally relaxed a little, the darn thing started again.
Then again…
And then again…
This continued for more than 300 times!
And it drove her crazy!
"That was the Universe! That happened because the Universe was enraged! It didn’t just happen in Yrniel, it happened all across the Universe! Even in Sylveris!"
Vulpiana declared confidently, and Faelara narrowed her eyes.

This wasn’t the first time she had heard of this. The Crimson Covenant Faction had a meeting regarding this before. It was something about how the worlds had started trembling together all at the same time. However, since they couldn’t find the reason behind this, the topic was never concluded and was buried under countless other, more important topics that the Faction actually had control over.
Faelara was the same. She simply thought of it as her Sector acting strangely and decided to look into it more later.
But now…
With her daughter telling her that the incident wasn’t related to just their sector but the entirety of the Universe…
Many questions filled her head.
The most important one, however, was,
Continue reading on freewebnovel
"How do you know this? And… what does this have to do with Nux? What makes you so sure that this incident is related to Nux?"
"I know it because I was there when it happened before!"
Faelara narrowed her eyes, and Vulpiana continued.
"I have spent months together with them. This isn’t the first time this has happened. I still remember the day when I was talking to Eisheth and Nux appeared.
Eisheth was confused because she thought Nux was ’busy’ with something, but just when she asked him about it,
The Universe trembled, and everything around us shook.

That time, instead of frowning or being alert like he normally would every time something out of expectation happened around him and his wives, Nux just smiled, and I still remember what he said back then,
’Do you sense it now?’
And Eisheth nodded at that response.

After this, I started noticing a pattern. Every time the Universe reacted, Nux was nowhere to be seen. A man like him, who is always around his wives, was never there moments before the Universe trembled.
This cannot be a coincidence, Mother.
That man is definitely the reason why the Universe trembles."
Vulpiana concluded, and at those words, Faelara froze, unable to comprehend what she just heard.
"I am telling you, Mother, Nux is definitely behind this. He didn’t get help fr—"
Suddenly, Vulpiana froze mid-sentence as well and glanced at her mother.
"Mother…"
She called out, her voice full of… suspicion.
"How do you know about Lord Azriel? I never told you about him."

"Don’t pin this on me, Mother.
Because of your actions, I was sent to Nux and the others as a spy, a spy whose existence as a spy was already known to everyone.
I couldn’t just trust what everyone told me; I had to filter out the information and verify it myself.
The same was true for the story of the Vampire Progenitor.
The being of absolute strength, Lady Aeliana’s father, the strongest Progenitor, the ’Secret Weapon,’ you think I believed those words when Eisheth told me about it?
Especially when she used that silly tone when she mentioned it?
’You wish to know about the Secret Weapon, don’t you? It’s Lord Azriel. The Vampire Progenitor.’

That was how she told me everything about him when I didn’t even ask about it. There were no tricks involved; I didn’t play any games. She just told me out of the blue, as if it was a way for her to pass time.
How was I supposed to believe it?
To this day, I didn’t believe this story; I thought the succubus was simply messing with me just like she always does. This was also the reason I never reported anything.
But you, Mother…

The biggest one was,
"Why?"
She asked.
"If you already knew of his existence, then why didn’t you ask him to save us?"
Vulpiana questioned and…
Faelara was silent, unable to form an answer.
Vulpiana didn’t back down either, staring at her mother until she got the answer she wanted to hear.

"To answer your question, I’ll start with telling you how I knew about the Vampire Progenitor in the first place."
Vulpiana nodded with a solemn look on her face, and Faelara waved her hand.

An image that made Vulpiana frown. The being looked extremely similar to her mother, almost to the point that it looked like Faelara had created her own portrait, but…
There was something odd.
Something Vulpiana had never seen before.
Eleven tails.
Yes, the fox had eleven tails, something Vulpiana had never seen before.
After all, nine tails meant Sovereign.
Ten tails meant Primordial.
And no fox went a level above that, no one except one…
"Vulpheon Chronoxis."
Faelara spoke as she stared at her daughter.
Vulpiana frowned, not knowing why her mother was suddenly talking about the Progenitor of their race.
"What we were told by our ancestors was wrong."
Faelara revealed.
"What do you mean?"

"Our world was being chased after by a High-Level World named Orynthar, which wanted to kill us all, take our Progenitor’s Bloodline, and give birth to a new being with our Bloodline, who is connected to their world."

That so-called ’plan’ was almost laughable."

Faelara spoke as she waved her hand, and suddenly, Vulpheon’s image started moving.

chapters.title: Chapter 1890: Not everyone around you is your Ally.
paragraphs: "Faelara Dawnshade."
Vulpheon’s image spoke.

"I do not know whether the name I referred to you by is correct or not. My powers are quite a mess right now, and… I do not have enough time and resources to figure things out, so you will have to bear with me.
My name is Vulpheon Chronoxis.
I am the Leader of Chronoxis, the world you initially came from, and the Progenitor of all the Foxkins.
If you are seeing this vision, it means my prediction regarding your birth was correct."
Vulpheon then smiled and,

"Congratulations. Becoming a Six-Tailed Fox at a mere age of fifty isn’t an achievement anyone can boast about. No, in truth, you are the only one who managed to reach this level at that age after me.
It is something you can proudly celebrate, my child."
When Vulpiana heard those words, she widened her eyes as she stared at her mother.
"Six tails at the age of… fifty…?"
It was absurd.
Something she had never heard of before.

The Dragon Hero became an Emperor at the age of 145, and that was the fastest of all the Heroes. Even Vulpiana only became an Emperor at 170, and yes, even though she was hiding her potential, never in her wildest dreams would she ever think of reaching that level before 50.
And then there’s her mother…
A being who became a… Great Sage…
At the age of fifty…
It was absurd.
This speed was simply unheard of.
No, why didn’t she know about this before?
Vulpiana started thinking. More and more questions appeared in her head. However, before she could say anything out loud, Faelara silenced her and pointed at the Fox Progenitor.
"The reason you are seeing me is complicated.

As I mentioned, my powers are a mess, and honestly, I was never strong enough to look into all possible futures and predict anything. I can only faintly sense your existence. My blood reacts to you, so while you may not be the new Progenitor of the Foxkin, you are definitely an existence whose potential is closest to mine."
The Progenitor’s face then turned solemn and,
"I am going to die soon."
She declared.
"We are attacked by a world we cannot defeat on our own, and I have found help. It is a low-level world named Yrniel. In Yrniel, there lives a being named Azriel Ruinous.
He is extremely strong.
Strong enough to deal with the threats we are facing, but to get his help, I will need to sacrifice my life.
So why am I doing… this?
You can call this desperation, or maybe a little act that will reassure my heart and make me feel better."
Vulpheon then looked forward and,
"Faelara, my child, I only wish the best for you and for the rest of my children. I want you to lead them. I want you to set them on the right path.
I chose Yrniel after many considerations, but I can predict that your ancestors won’t be satisfied with my decision and will try to cause problems.
I want you to resolve all those problems and live together with Yrniel.
Even if your ancestors have made too many mistakes, even if your situation is irredeemable, I assure you, if you go to Azriel Ruinous, he will accept you. He will make you part of Yrniel.
Grow together with him. Become his support.
And under your leadership,
I can see the Foxkins thrive like never before.
Now, before I go, there are some things I would like to share with you—the secrets behind my power, my comprehension that others cannot understand, but…
You can."
Vulpheon spoke as a meaningful look appeared on her face. She then started saying things Vulpiana couldn’t understand. Faelara’s eyes, however, shined as the woman continued.
It was as if she was reciting everything she had learned in her mind. Something Vulpiana found quite intriguing.
The lecture continued for an hour, and then,
"This is all the time I had."
Vulpheon then stared at Faelara one last time and,
Your next chapter is on freewebnovel
"Please take care of yourself and everyone around you, my child.
I will always be watching and supporting you."
As she said those words, Vulpheon’s body flickered before it disappeared from existence.
Vulpiana turned silent.
Honestly, her mind was still stuck on the fact that her mother became a Six-Tailed Fox at the mere age of fifty. It was simply absurd.
But…
It didn’t make sense.
Her mother had always been considered to be among the foxes with high potential, but… she was never considered to be the best.
There were people who were better or on a similar level as her.
Just like now, her mother was almost 6000 years old, and she still hadn’t broken through to the Primordial Phase.
Something that someone with her potential should have done a long time ago. Or…
Was the Progenitor mistaken…?
Vulpiana considered that possibility as well.
And as if Faelara read her mind,
"I can be a Primordial anytime I wish to.
I just do not wish to attract too much attention."
The fox’s face then turned serious and,
"Not everyone around you is your ally, Vul. Always keep this in your mind."
Vulpiana nodded.
It made sense, especially in her mother’s position, where her life was in the hands of enemies and there were spies all around her.
But…
"My question is still the same.
If you knew about the Vampire Progenitor, why didn’t you go to him?"
Vulpiana questioned, and at her question, Faelara frowned.
She looked confused as to why Vulpiana even asked this question, as if she should already know the answer by now.
Faelara, however, decided to take it slow and explained her thought process.
"At first, I didn’t know what to do with everything Lady Vulpheon told me. I was too immature back then, so I simply focused on her teachings and decided to form my path.
However, as I grew and learned about Sylveris and our ’mission’ to find out about the secret weapon,
It all became clear to me."

chapters.title: Chapter 1891: Not everyone around you is your Ally. 2
paragraphs: "At first, I didn’t know what to do with everything Lady Vulpheon told me. I was too immature back then, so I simply focused on her teachings and decided to form my Path.
However, as I grew and learned about Sylveris and our ’mission’ to find out about the secret weapon,
It all became clear to me."
Vulpiana narrowed her eyes at those words.
Faelara continued,
"The secret weapon those otherworlders wanted to know about was none other than Azriel Ruinous, the Progenitor mentioned."
"Yes, I get that."
Vulpiana nodded, unable to understand what her mother was trying to get at.
"Vul, do you not understand?"
Faelara questioned.
"That man is a secret weapon that killed a Transcendent within a matter of seconds. Do you really think any random being can do it? Especially a being from a Low-Level World?"
Vulpiana’s frown became deeper and deeper.
"That man helped our Progenitor deal with a High-Level World, accepted our entire race as a part of Yrniel, and is powerful enough to kill Transcendents without anyone even knowing how.
None of this made sense.
Something wasn’t adding up.
A being from a Low-Level World wasn’t supposed to be that strong.
He must have a secret,
Something…
Anything."
"Mother… what did you do?"
Vulpiana narrowed her eyes.
"I did what every sane being would do,
I desired that power.
The absolute power that could make me the strongest."
Faelara stared at her daughter and,
"Yrniel is special, Vul.
It is no ordinary Low-Level World, it is something extremely special. So, if I get my hands on it, I will be special as well."
Vulpiana’s expression changed. Faelara, however, did not stop there. It was just the beginning.
"Of course, be that as it may, I knew I was helpless against that being.

So I followed our ancestors’ arrangements and remained in contact with the otherworlders. The plan was simple. I wanted to find out Azriel’s limit and slowly but surely bring an enemy strong enough to self-destruct together with him.
But very quickly, I realized that wasn’t possible.

That man seemed to have no limits. Every time Yrniel was in trouble, he eradicated the said trouble within seconds. It didn’t matter if the enemy was a Sovereign, a Primordial, or even a Transcendent, he was too strong, and the otherworlders, after the death of a Transcendent, had become too paranoid.
I couldn’t do anything.
I had no other choice but to give in.
I even thought of going to the Vampire Progenitor, seeking his help, and living under his protection, but then,
He appeared."
"He?"
"The Devil."
Faelara spoke with a playful smile on her face.
Continue your adventure at freewebnovel
"That child who managed to defeat the Seven Heroes like they were nothing. A child who even defeated you."
Vulpiana frowned.
"It started with a small interest at first, but the more I learned about Nux, the more my interest grew.
Defeating the Heroes, even the Dragon Hero, who was a stage above him, and then challenging a Sovereign.
Slowly, I realized it,
That child’s talents were higher than mine.
No, he was on an entirely different level.
He was like…
Azriel."
Faelara spoke as her eyes shined,
"However, there was a difference between the two.
Unlike Azriel,
He hadn’t fully grown yet.
If it is his talent, his secret…
I could steal it.
So, my focus shifted to him. I wanted to know the source of his absurd talent. I wanted to know what his secret was, but the information about him was limited.
That man, however, had one weakness, or maybe I should call it an opening."
Vulpiana narrowed her eyes when she heard those words. She didn’t like where this was going.
And Faelara, who could read her daughter’s expression, smiled,
"Yes, it was women.
That boy trusts his women almost blindly. If I could become one of his women, he will tell me everything I want to know without any resistance whatsoever.
But…
Then I realized another thing,

That boy was more careful than he looked. He was too protective of his women, and his women were extremely perceptive as well. If I got close to him, the chances of him or his women sensing that something was wrong were high,
But…"
"So you decided to send me to them instead."
Vulpiana completed her mother’s sentence, and Faelara nodded.
"That is correct.
And the reason I didn’t tell you anything was because I wanted you to get close to him without him or his wives suspecting anything."
"Then why send me as a spy?"
Vulpiana couldn’t understand.
It almost felt like her mother was purposefully making things difficult for her.
"What mother would send her daughter away without a reason? I sent you there because I ’wanted to protect you.’
And that spy thing was nothing more than for them to let their guard down around you. I wanted to come straight so they would not doubt you. Yes, they would be careful around you, but…"
Faelara stared at her daughter and smiled,
"I knew that if you stayed around him, he would fall for you eventually and open up.
And see? He fell for you, just like I thought."
"What?"
Vulpiana frowned.
"Hmm?"
Faelara frowned as well.
"What do you mean he fell for me?"
Vulpiana frowned, and at that question, Faelara laughed out loud.
"Oh, my sweet little daughter, how are you so oblivious?
That man destroyed five Middle-Level Worlds for your sake. Do you think he would do that for any random woman?"
"So he… likes me?"
"Of course, he does. Do you think he has what it takes to control himself?"
Faelara laughed.
"My plan was successful. He fell for you.
I just needed a few more years to know everything I wanted to know through you, but…"
Faelara just sighed self-deprecatingly.
"But?"
Vulpiana frowned.
"I underestimated him."
"What?"
"That child managed to destroy Middle-Level Worlds on his own. He is the one the Universe is after. Someone that makes the entire Universe react to his movements.
Whatever his source of power is,
It is something much grander than what I can ever handle."
"Then… are you going to give up like before and finally accept his help?"
Vulpiana questioned. At her words, however, Faelara blinked.
"Give up? What do you mean?"
"Huh?"
Vulpiana frowned, and as if wanting to wake her sleeping child up, Faelara snapped her fingers in front of Vulpiana and,
"Vul, he is a man the Universe is after, and only we know that.
If we reveal this information to… let’s say the Supreme Worlds, they might even allow us to become a part of them, raising our potential to an absurd level.
If that happened, Transcendent wouldn’t be our limit anymore.
All of that just by providing his information to the people who want it.
There is no easier way out."
Faelara’s smile widened, liking her newest plan more and more.

But…"
"So you decided to send me to them instead."
Vulpiana completed her mother’s sentence, and Faelara nodded.
"That is correct.
And the reason I didn’t tell you anything was because I wanted you to get close to him without him or his wives suspecting anything."
"Then why send me as a spy?"
Vulpiana couldn’t understand.
It almost felt like her mother was purposefully making things difficult for her.
"What mother would send her daughter away without a reason?
I sent you there because I ’wanted to protect you.’
And that spy thing was nothing more than for them to let their guard down around you.
I wanted to come straight so they would not doubt you.
Yes, they would be careful around you, but…"
Faelara stared at her daughter and smiled,
"I knew that if you stayed around him, he would fall for you eventually and open up.
And see?
He fell for you, just like I thought."
"What?"
Vulpiana frowned.
"Hmm?"
Faelara frowned as well.
"What do you mean he fell for me?"
Vulpiana frowned, and at that question, Faelara laughed out loud.
"Oh, my sweet little daughter, how are you so oblivious?
That man destroyed five Middle-Level Worlds for your sake.
Do you think he would do that for any random woman?"
"So he… likes me?"
"Of course, he does.
Do you think he has what it takes to control himself?"
Faelara laughed.
"My plan was successful.
He fell for you.
I just needed a few more years to know everything I wanted to know through you, but…"
Faelara just sighed self-deprecatingly.
"But?"
Vulpiana frowned.
"I underestimated him."
"What?"
"That child managed to destroy Middle-Level Worlds on his own.
He is the one the Universe is after.
Someone that makes the entire Universe react to his movements.
Whatever his source of power is,
It is something much grander than what I can ever handle."
"Then… are you going to give up like before and finally accept his help?"
Vulpiana questioned.
At her words, however, Faelara blinked.
"Give up?
What do you mean?"
"Huh?"
Vulpiana frowned, and as if wanting to wake her sleeping child up, Faelara snapped her fingers in front of Vulpiana and,
"Vul, he is a man the Universe is after, and only we know that.
If we reveal this information to… let’s say the Supreme Worlds, they might even allow us to become a part of them, raising our potential to an absurd level.
If that happened, Transcendent wouldn’t be our limit anymore.
All of that just by providing his information to the people who want it.
There is no easier way out."
Faelara’s smile widened, liking her newest plan more and more.

"Do you think that’s possible?"

"That man destroyed five Middle-Level Worlds for a woman. Who is to say he wouldn’t be attracted to another woman in the future and do something even bolder next?

Heck, I wouldn’t be surprised if they are already looking for him."

"What if… the Supreme Worlds just get the information from us and get rid of us?"
Vulpiana questioned.
"That is possible. I will not deny that."
Faelara nodded.

"What?"
Vulpiana leaned forward.
"It is the two of us."
"The two of us…?"

A journey that will change our fate."

And at that time, we will be in front of them as enemies.
That’s a certain death, and my path is a probable death where the other result is lifelong glory and power.
The choice should be very clear, my daughter."

paragraphs: "But if we don’t do anything, we die as well.

The choice should be very clear, my daughter."
Faelara spoke as she looked into her daughter’s eyes, as if waiting for her decision.
Vulpiana was silent. There were too many things going on in her head. Faelara didn’t rush her either.
The only person she cared about was standing in front of her, and she wanted her daughter to be with her in this plan of hers.
"B-But our people…"
Vulpiana brought back the same topic, and Faelara’s answer was the same.
"They will not survive.
Yrniel will be destroyed in the future. It will attract attention once the Supremes come after Nux.
Vul, we cannot protect everyone.
I never cared about everyone.
I only cared about myself, and when you came, I only cared about the two of us."
"…What about Nux?"
Vulpiana questioned with a hesitant look on her face.
"He did all of this for us…
Even if his actions attracted the Supreme Worlds’ attention, he did it to… protect us…
Do you want us to, no,
Do you want me to… betray him?"
"You are not going to betray him, Vul.
It was very clear from the start that you were a spy. I told him that when I sent you with him. You were never on his side to begin with.
You were always on my side.
And do not fool me, my daughter."
Faelara called out.
"I know Aghaast was never able to ’Mark’ the real you. You managed to fool me with your powers. There is no way you couldn’t fool that idiot too.
Your life was never in true danger, was it?"
Vulpiana turned silent.
There was no point in hiding it from her mother. She already knew what her Law was and how it worked.
"B-But he freed you…"
Vulpiana still didn’t give in, but at those words, Faelara scoffed.
"You underestimate me, my daughter.
Do you truly believe I would let a fool like Aghaast control my life?"
"What…?"
"I teleported that ’Mark’ out of my body long ago. My life was never in danger. The only reason I listened to that fool’s orders was because it all aligned with my plans."
Vulpiana turned silent.
She was seeing her mother’s new side, a side much more calculative and… scary.
"Nux didn’t save any of us, Vul.
He just did everything because he desired us.

Think about it, he endangered the lives of his wives he cares so much about for some new women he found interesting, and I assure you, he will continue doing that in the future for some other newer women.
He is a fool that thinks with the lower half of his body.
Siding with him will only bring us close to death."
Vulpiana lowered her head, not saying anything.
Until finally, Faelara extended her hands.
"I have planned and prepared everything for the two of us, and I want you right next to me, like it is supposed to be."
She spoke, her eyes only reflecting love, care, and… worry for her daughter.
Vulpiana, who saw those eyes, turned weak.
Her mother…
In the end, she clenched her fists and,
Held her mother’s hand.
"What do you want me to do?"
She decided to choose the woman who had always been with her and did everything for their sake.
She decided… to be selfish.
"You need to get to the Supreme Worlds and tell them everything you know about Nux."
Faelara laid out the instructions.
"Only the two of us know this. I cannot leave because Azriel or the Progenitors are still keeping an eye on me, but you can fool them.
Your Law makes it possible for you to sneak out.
I’ll help you teleport to a dimension under my control. You should already have enough experience in Outer Space travel now.
I have also prepared all the resources you would need in your journey."
Faelara then passed an artifact to Vulpiana and,
"When you get there, activate this artifact. It will allow me to project myself there, and I can negotiate on our behalf. You will then…"
Faelara continued to explain everything, and the more she spoke, the more Vulpiana realized how well-prepared her mother was.
She could tell how much thought she had put into all of this, considering every possible scenario and their outcomes.
The woman had even considered scenarios that led to her death, and if she couldn’t counter them, she simply accepted her death in all.
She was well-prepared, and as Vulpiana continued to hear her, she steeled herself as well.
But then,
"So when t-"
Faelara suddenly paused.
"Mother?"
Vulpiana called out.
Faelara stared at her daughter and narrowed her eyes.
"Vul, what did you do?"
"What do you mean?"
Vulpiana frowned.
And seeing her expression, Faelara quickly realized her daughter was innocent.
Right now, however, she didn’t have time to think of such matters. She had bigger problems to deal with.
"Mother, what happened?"
Vulpiana questioned.
"Someone is trying to enter this dimension."

"What? Who is i-"
Before Vulpiana could complete, her expression changed.
"Mother, is it-"
"I do not know.
But no one should be able to enter this dimension since it shouldn’t exist in realit-"
*RUMBLE RUMBLE RUMBLE*
The ’Space’ shook, and Faelara’s eyes widened in horror.
"What is happening!?"
"Mother!?"
"I cannot resist the weight of whatever’s trying to enter!"
Faelara stated the problem, and as if on cue.
*Crack*
A large crack appeared in the dimension the two of them were in, and suddenly,
An extremely handsome, black-haired man with almost hypnotizing golden eyes walked out of the crack with a playful smile on his face.
"That’s quite a detailed plan, even if I do say so myself."
He praised as he glanced at Faelara.
"You failed to consider one thing, though."
Nux paused, and his grin turned demonic.
"Me."

"Well, I guess it wasn’t completely out of my expectation.
It would be foolish to expect a daughter to go after her mother.
I thought it would work if I showed you your mother’s real face. Oh well, at least I tried."
Nux then started stretching his body as if he was preparing for something.
"Well, since Plan A failed, it’s time to go for Plan B."
Nux’s eyes shined as he stared at Faelara.
"After all, I always get what I desire."
Faelara narrowed her eyes. However, before she could say anything,
"W-Wait, a-are you saying that my mother wasn’t on your side?"
Vulpiana questioned.
"Hmm?"
Nux glanced at Vulpiana mid-stretch and,
"My side? I never consider anyone other than my wives to be on my side.
I just knew that this woman wasn’t on your side."
"How did you know...? What gave it away?"
Faelara questioned in a grim tone.
"Come on, Faelara Dawnshade.
You didn’t actually think I bought that story of yours, did you?
I would be quite disappointed if you did.
Even if I do think with just my lower half, trust me, my lower half is extremely good. I’ve only gotten good reviews till now."

"Quite rich coming from a Sovereign."
"A Sovereign who can—"
Nux spoke as he suddenly disappeared, and then, appeared at the same spot with a second Vulpiana in his hands,
"—see through tricks you cannot."
He completed his sentence.
Vulpiana, who was in his arms, tried to resist.
"You will stay hidden until I call for you."

[Yes.]

"I need her alive."

She had removed the restrictions that stopped Vulpiana from using her ability.
"Promise me that no matter the result, you will spare her life."
The Mother Fox spoke.
"Heh."
Nux chuckled.
"Stop being dramatic.
You are both dying once I get your Laws."

"Our Laws, huh…

Law of Absolute Space, eh?

"Let’s see you try and get it."

Faelara chuckled as suddenly, the Space around Nux acted strangely. The Space expanded and collapsed endlessly. Nux felt a foreign force pulling him from every direction. It was as if reality itself was trying to rip him into pieces.
But…
Nothing happened.
Nux just stared at the woman in front of him, not resisting her powers in any way.
"Your weight…
You are much heavier than any normal entity."
Faelara narrowed her eyes.
She had tried to tear Nux apart using the Power of Space, but… she couldn’t even move him.
And this wasn’t the first time this had happened either. Before, when she tried to stop Nux from entering her dimension, she realized that she couldn’t resist his weight.
It was as if something had thrown the weight of an entire world on top of her.
Nux just chuckled at those words, not saying anything.
Faelara wasn’t expecting an answer either. The space around her trembled, and suddenly, thousands of spatial spikes formed all around Nux, ready to pierce him from every direction.
With a flick of Faelara’s fingers, the spikes rushed toward Nux, ready to pierce countless holes in his body.
Nux, however, dodged them all.
His training with Aeliana had pushed the Zenith Flow back to how it was before—no, this time, it was even better since Nux had now added his enhanced strength into it.
Dodging an attack like this was child’s play for him.
However…
Faelara’s attacks were endless.
No matter how many spikes Nux dodged, more and more formed from the Space around him and continued to attack.
The spikes he had dodged before didn’t just disappear either; they rushed back and tried to attack him again as well.
It was only getting more and more difficult as the number of spikes increased.
And since these spikes were made from the Space itself and had Faelara’s energy inside them—an energy of higher quality than Nux’s—they could very well injure him, and he knew it as well.
Realizing that he could not stay on the defensive for long, Nux activated his ability and teleported next to Faelara.
Or… that was what he was trying to do.
He, however, realized that he had appeared in a random place. He tried to teleport again, but once again, instead of appearing next to Faelara, he appeared at a random place.
But Nux didn’t give in.
He continued to teleport himself again and again, trying to reduce the distance between the two of them, but he failed every single time.
It was as if some sort of force was messing with his skill.
Faelara, who saw that, couldn’t help but laugh.
"How brutish."
"You have tampered with the Law of Space in this dimension."
Faelara heard Nux’s words and chuckled.
"I didn’t think you would catch on this quickly.
That is correct, I did that.
The Space Laws bend according to my will here. If you wish to use your skill correctly, you either need to understand my will,
Or calculate millions of possibilities to figure out the new Space Laws I have set and use your ability accordingly.
It won’t take long, just a few thousand yea—"
Before the woman could even complete her words,
"What a coincidence,
I just did that."
Suddenly, Faelara’s eyes widened in horror as she heard Nux’s voice.
A voice that came from behind.
The Fox turned around, but then,
BOOOOOOOM

chapters.title: Chapter 1896: I should have been faster.
paragraphs: "What a coincidence,
I just did that."
Suddenly, Faelara’s eyes widened in horror as she heard Nux’s voice.
A voice that came from behind.
The Fox turned around, but before she could react,
Nux punched.
BOOOOOOOM
"H-How did you…?"
Faelara couldn’t believe what she was seeing. However, she wasn’t the only one in disbelief.
Nux was the same.
After all, the woman in front of him was fine even after taking the full force of his punch.
Well, she didn’t exactly ’take’ on his punch; she redirected all that force to another place, but to think she was able to redirect everything and be completely fine…
’It’s like [Mirror], but much more effective.’
Nux thought inwardly as he stared at Faelara.
The Fox, on the other hand, teleported away, creating distance between the two of them.
"How did you do it!?"
She screamed, her eyes still wide in horror.
No…
This wasn’t possible…
This man didn’t just do what she was thinking…
It was a fluke!
A fluke!
As if wanting to prove her wrong, Nux teleported next to her again,
Or he tried to… but he failed.
Yes, the Fox had bent the Space Laws again.

This, however, didn’t stop Nux before; it wouldn’t do it again. The madman continued to try and teleport next to Faelara. Every time he failed, he simply teleported again, and on his fifth try, he appeared right behind her.
BOOOOOOM
Nux punched again, and just like before, the damage was redirected.
The Fox was completely unharmed, physically that is.
Her mind, on the other hand, was falling apart.
’H-He… calculated all the possibilities and figured out a way to teleport correctly… within a few seconds…’
It was absurd.
It made no sense.
It was no different than comprehending an entirely different set of Space Laws by trial and error, and…
And this monster did that in a few seconds…
Faelara teleported again. Once again, she changed the Space Laws, and this time, Nux managed to teleport next to her on his third attempt, horrifying Faelara to a greater extent.
BOOOOOOM
He punched again, and once again, his power was redirected.
Nux frowned.
This wasn’t working.
He had tried it three times now, but no matter where he attacked from or what angle he used, he couldn’t harm Faelara in any way.
The barrier surrounded her entire body, protecting her from any attack whatsoever. It was impossible to hurt her.
And the place he was in wasn’t helping either.
To Nux, it felt like he was facing a Transcendent. This place was no different than Faelara’s Domain. She had pretty much erased the concept of ’running’ here.
The space here stretched endlessly, so the distance between Nux and Faelara was increasing constantly. If he tried to run to her, he would continue to run for an eternity.
The only way to get close to Faelara was to teleport next to her, and with her constantly bending the Space Laws, even that wasn’t easy.
And after all this, even if he did get close to her, his punch had no effect on her.
What’s worse?
Nux couldn’t stay in one place for long either because of these Spatial Spikes that could form from literal space around him and attacked him endlessly.
’This woman’s a cheat.’
Nux cursed in his head.
First, she takes away the enemy’s movements,
Then, she makes it impossible for the enemy to get close to her since she bends the very Laws of Spatial Movement.
Even if an enemy manages to get close to her, their attacks are redirected to another space, and even in this absurd situation,
She makes sure the enemy doesn’t have time to stay in a place and think of a solution, as the Spatial Spikes continue to harass them.
It was absurd,
The Law of Absolute Space was simply too powerful.
Faelara was pretty much undefeatable, especially when her Quality of Energy was higher than Nux’s.
’No, this does not make sense.’
Nux shook his head as he stared at the Fox standing in front of him.
Faelara’s Law was simply too powerful. It was almost invincible, but…
’If her Law was truly as powerful as I think it is…
She wouldn’t have put in so much effort to make herself look invincible.
Taking away my movement, bending space laws, the barrier, these spikes…
If her Law was truly powerful, she would only rely on her barrier and do whatever she wanted.’
Nux’s line of thought began to change, and with that, his eyes shined. Read latest stories on freewebnovel
The Fox was trying to hide her weakness, a weakness Nux didn’t know about.
He just needed to find out what it i-
Suddenly, Nux’s expression changed as he recalled something.
It was a battle between Vyriana and Zyros.
’Your ability only works on ’push.’
If I ’push’ force towards you, your ability will deflect it to your surroundings, but…
If I ’pull’ it instead,
Your ability fails.’
These were the words Vyriana had said when Zyros used Astral Anchoring against her.
"Heh."
Nux’s grin widened as he stared at the Fox.
Faelara frowned, not liking this man’s expression one bit. Yes, till now, he was unable to hurt her, but the Fox was paranoid. This man was simply too ridiculous; his comprehension speed was absurd.
’What in the hell is up with this monster!?’
Faelara was in disbelief.

She had constantly been bending the Space Laws as fast as she could, but every single time, he comprehended the new Laws and teleported right next to her. It was almost as if his comprehension speed was as fast, if not even faster, than her thought process.
It didn’t make any sense!
Faelara’s body trembled. When she realized he was trying to get close to her, she quickly bent the Space Laws of this dimension.
Once again, it turned into a race between them where she needed to bend the Laws again before Nux comprehended them, and just like before, she won the first few rounds, but then,
She failed.
And Nux appeared right behind her.
’I should have been faster.’
She cursed in her head, ready to take another punch before teleporting again, but this time,
Something changed.
Tap
Instead of punching her, Nux grabbed her arm.

The madman continued to try and teleport next to Faelara.
Every time he failed, he simply teleported again, and on his fifth try, he appeared right behind her.
BOOOOOOM
Nux punched again, and just like before, the damage was redirected.
The Fox was completely unharmed, physically that is.
Her mind, on the other hand, was falling apart.
’H-He… calculated all the possibilities and figured out a way to teleport correctly… within a few seconds…’
It was absurd.
It made no sense.
It was no different than comprehending an entirely different set of Space Laws by trial and error, and…
And this monster did that in a few seconds…
Faelara teleported again.
Once again, she changed the Space Laws, and this time, Nux managed to teleport next to her on his third attempt, horrifying Faelara to a greater extent.
BOOOOOOM
He punched again, and once again, his power was redirected.
Nux frowned.
This wasn’t working.
He had tried it three times now, but no matter where he attacked from or what angle he used, he couldn’t harm Faelara in any way.
The barrier surrounded her entire body, protecting her from any attack whatsoever.
It was impossible to hurt her.
And the place he was in wasn’t helping either.
To Nux, it felt like he was facing a Transcendent.
This place was no different than Faelara’s Domain.
She had pretty much erased the concept of ’running’ here.
The space here stretched endlessly, so the distance between Nux and Faelara was increasing constantly.
If he tried to run to her, he would continue to run for an eternity.
The only way to get close to Faelara was to teleport next to her, and with her constantly bending the Space Laws, even that wasn’t easy.
And after all this, even if he did get close to her, his punch had no effect on her.
What’s worse?
Nux couldn’t stay in one place for long either because of these Spatial Spikes that could form from literal space around him and attacked him endlessly.
’This woman’s a cheat.’
Nux cursed in his head.
First, she takes away the enemy’s movements,
Then, she makes it impossible for the enemy to get close to her since she bends the very Laws of Spatial Movement.
Even if an enemy manages to get close to her, their attacks are redirected to another space, and even in this absurd situation,
She makes sure the enemy doesn’t have time to stay in a place and think of a solution, as the Spatial Spikes continue to harass them.
It was absurd,
The Law of Absolute Space was simply too powerful.
Faelara was pretty much undefeatable, especially when her Quality of Energy was higher than Nux’s.
’No, this does not make sense.’
Nux shook his head as he stared at the Fox standing in front of him.
Faelara’s Law was simply too powerful.
It was almost invincible, but…
’If her Law was truly as powerful as I think it is…
She wouldn’t have put in so much effort to make herself look invincible.
Taking away my movement, bending space laws, the barrier, these spikes…
If her Law was truly powerful, she would only rely on her barrier and do whatever she wanted.’
Nux’s line of thought began to change, and with that, his eyes shined.
Read latest stories on freewebnovel
The Fox was trying to hide her weakness, a weakness Nux didn’t know about.
He just needed to find out what it i-
Suddenly, Nux’s expression changed as he recalled something.
It was a battle between Vyriana and Zyros.
’Your ability only works on ’push.’
If I ’push’ force towards you, your ability will deflect it to your surroundings, but…
If I ’pull’ it instead,
Your ability fails.’
These were the words Vyriana had said when Zyros used Astral Anchoring against her.
"Heh."
Nux’s grin widened as he stared at the Fox.
Faelara frowned, not liking this man’s expression one bit.
Yes, till now, he was unable to hurt her, but the Fox was paranoid.
This man was simply too ridiculous; his comprehension speed was absurd.
’What in the hell is up with this monster!?’
Faelara was in disbelief.
She had constantly been bending the Space Laws as fast as she could, but every single time, he comprehended the new Laws and teleported right next to her.
It was almost as if his comprehension speed was as fast, if not even faster, than her thought process.
It didn’t make any sense!
Faelara’s body trembled.
When she realized he was trying to get close to her, she quickly bent the Space Laws of this dimension.
Once again, it turned into a race between them where she needed to bend the Laws again before Nux comprehended them, and just like before, she won the first few rounds, but then,
She failed.
And Nux appeared right behind her.
’I should have been faster.’
She cursed in her head, ready to take another punch before teleporting again, but this time,
Something changed.
Tap
Instead of punching her, Nux grabbed her arm.

chapters.title: Chapter 1897: How was a Sovereign… doing this?
paragraphs: ’W-What?’
Faelara stared at the man standing in front of her in disbelief.
’W-What is he trying to do?’
She wondered in her head, confused as to why this man was holding her hand.
Yes, Faelara was intimidated.
A monster like this shouldn’t exist!

Every time Nux comprehended the new Laws she set faster than she could change them inside her own dimension, Faelara was horrified. It felt like she was facing an omniscient god who could see right through her.
Every time this man did something different, it alerted her.
It was the same when this man held her arm instead of punching her.
The Fox used all her strength to free her arm, but… in the contest of strength, she stood no chance.
’How is he so strong!? He is only a Sovereign!’
Faelara screamed in anger and frustration.

With trembling eyes, she stared at the human in front of her, who looked no different than a demon. Then suddenly, Nux tightened his grip around her arm, and when she realized what he was trying to do,
Whoosh Whoosh Whoosh
Faelara summoned hundreds of thousands of Spatial Spikes, trying to get rid of him.
Nux, however, completely ignored the spikes, and with a crazed look on his face, he pulled.
Faelara’s eyes widened in horror, and knowing she had no way out of this,
She teleported away.
Yes, she teleported away, and her arm…
It stayed with Nux.
"AAAAGGGGGGGHHHHHHHHHH!!!!"
The Fox screamed in agony, and blood gushed out of her shoulder.
As for Nux, he simply dodged the spikes that attacked him with a bloodied smile on his face before he teleported away and appeared in a different place.
"So it works."
He smiled as he threw the woman’s arm away.
"Next time, instead of your arm, I just need to aim for your head."
The man prepared himself, his grin becoming more and more demonic, while the Fox’s face paled as she lost more and more blood.
Ba-dump Ba-dump Ba-dump
Her heartbeat quickened, the agonizing pain made her writhe, her body trembled, her bleeding wasn’t stopping, but despite that,
Her mind didn’t stop racing.
Yes, even now, she was constantly bending Space Laws around her, making sure Nux didn’t get close to her again.
It was as if she was a trapped, desperate teenager, trying to do everything she could in order to keep the demon away from her, but in both cases, there was one thing in common,
They never succeeded.
And Faelara knew she would lose the race eventually, so this time, instead of trying to resist pointlessly, she did something else. Read new chapters at freewebnovel
Whoosh Whoosh Whoosh
The space around her moved, forming something that resembled a mirror, a bunch of them.

Since this was a dimension she created from scratch, it was easier to control things here. Within a few seconds, the Fox filled the entire space with countless mirrors, and as her reflection was seen on every single one of these mirrors, countless Faelaras now stood in front of Nux.
What’s worse?
The Fox manipulated the Laws of Space in such a way that she was all of these Faelaras at the same time.
Yes, these Faelaras weren’t just her reflections, they were all her and… not her…
"These cloning abilities have gotten too far."
Nux scratched his head. This one, however, was easier to deal with than the others. The concept behind these clones was these Spatial Mirrors, correct?
Didn’t that mean he just needed to destroy them?
BOOOOOOOM
Nux unleashed his punch, breaking the ’mirrors’ in front of him.
This, however, didn’t solve his problem.
The mirrors broke into countless more mirrors, creating more and more Faelaras, and maybe because the Fox wanted to play with his mind,
"Forget it, Nux Leander.𝚏𝗿𝗲𝐞𝚠𝕖𝐛𝗻𝗼𝐯𝕖𝚕.𝚌𝗼𝗺
You cannot defeat me."

Thousands of Faelaras declared at the same time, and to make everything even more confusing, Faelara manipulated the space and moved all the mirrors in different directions, pulling Nux into a dimension where his perception was put to the test.
But…
"Trust me, it doesn’t sound very intimidating when you say that with tears on your face."
To Nux, these petty tricks didn’t matter.
Nux wasn’t a child. With millions of years of information in his head, Faelara wasn’t the first ’tricky’ opponent he was facing, and she definitely wouldn’t be the last.
Against tricky beings like Faelara,
Nux had a simple solution.
Force.
If force wasn’t solving the problem, it meant that you simply weren’t using enough of it.
So Nux…
He decided to punch again,
Then again,
And again.
BOOOOOOM BOOOOOOM BOOOOOOM
Yes, the madman started punching again and again, until the ’mirrors’ were crushed into nothingness and all of Faelaras disappeared like they never existed.
Of course, the Fox tried to regenerate the mirrors, but against Nux’s strength, it was useless. The man destroyed anything before it was even created.
The Fox was helpless.
"Forget it, Faelara Dawnshade.
You cannot defeat me."
Nux repeated Faelara’s words, looking right into the Fox’s eyes.
"You can be proud of yourself; you were one of the trickiest opponents I’ve faced.
Even Aeliana would have a hard time defeating you, and to think you broke through just a few minutes ago,
Your Law is indeed quite strong. Perhaps one of the strongest Laws I have encountered, and it is a big praise since it’s coming from me."
Nux wasn’t being arrogant or condescending. As someone who had seen memories of a High-Level World like Umbrasol, his words indeed meant a lot.
However,
The Fox still hadn’t given up.
Suddenly, the space around her cracked, and three beings appeared beside her, confused. Clearly, they weren’t expecting to be called here.
"Faelara?"
Lysander Dawnshade frowned.
"What happened to your arm!?"
Aerion shouted.
"I will explain everything later. For now, focus on him."
Faelara answered as she pointed at Nux.
"Nux…?"
The Black Order Leaders frowned.
They recognized this man.
Wasn’t he the same man Faelara was relying on just a few hours ago? Why was he standing against her now?
And…
When did Faelara become a Primordial?
There were too many questions in their heads, but,
"I’ll answer all your questions later.
For now,
Focus on capturing him alive.
If that is not possible,
Kill him."
Faelara spoke coldly.
Her priorities had changed.
Right now, capturing him and reporting to Supreme Worlds didn’t matter. Her life was at stake here. She needed to survive.
Nux was a threat she couldn’t ignore.
"Get in formation."
The Fox ordered.
Honestly, the three of them weren’t exactly her allies either, but she knew if she played her moves right, she would be able to use them to her advantage.
And it worked.
The three Black Order Leaders, as confused as they were, decided to side with Faelara and,
BOOOM BOOOM BOOOM
They released their Auras, their eyes observing Nux.
Seeing him picking his ear nonchalantly as if their Auras didn’t exist made them widen their eyes in disbelief.
How was a Sovereign… doing this?
How was he not affected by their Auras?
The shock, however, didn’t last long. They were half expecting it to fail anyway. After all, if Aura worked, Faelara, even if she was a new Primordial, wouldn’t be in such a state and summon them.
This man was no ordinary Sovereign...
Their instincts warned them…
This Sovereign,
He might be the strongest enemy they had ever faced. So the Foxes decided to go all out from the start.
Yes, they weren’t planning to hold back, even if the child in front of them was merely a Sovereign.
They didn’t make it this far being careless.
If they deemed something to be a threat, they used everything they had to get rid of it.
And this child will be the same. They will capture him first and then find out what in the hell happened here.
"Reinforcements? Really?"
Nux, on the other hand, seemed disappointed.
