chapters.title: Chapter 1898: Too late, buddy.
paragraphs: "What in the hell is wrong with this place!?"
"I cannot use my Law properly!"
"What did you do!?"
The Black Order Leaders stared at Nux and screamed in disbelief.
’Yes! Exactly! That’s the normal reaction!’
Faelara, on the other hand, felt like her faith in the Universe was being restored.
She wasn’t disappointed by the Leaders’ reaction.

No, not at all. Their Laws were all related to either Space or Time, so it was obvious they would have a difficult time fighting here since she had momentarily forgotten that she had bent the Space Laws here.
This was how a normal being was supposed to act.
Frustrated, shocked, scared even.
You shouldn’t be trying to force your way through it, thinking you can comprehend the new Laws, and actually do it!
That still makes no sense!
Faelara then waved her hand, and the Space Laws returned to normal. There was no point in bending them anyway; that monster would comprehend it again, and it would be a wasted effort.
At the very least, right now, her ’allies’ could use their powers and be of some help.
"His ability doesn’t last long. You should be able to use it now."
Faelara informed, shifting the blame onto Nux.
"What a vile ability!"
"The information didn’t say anything regarding him being able to manipulate Space."
"The information about him was always limited. We need to be careful."
The Leaders discussed with solemn looks on their faces, easily buying Faelara’s lies.
Once again, Faelara stared at the Leaders and didn’t seem disappointed. Rather, she nodded in satisfaction.
Her thoughts were reaffirmed yet again.
This is how one is supposed to act when they have absolutely no clue regarding the situation. You are supposed to trust the person you know, not doubt everything.
She wasn’t the weird one here, nor were the Leaders.
It was this monster in front of her.
Faelara stared at Nux, who hadn’t done anything all this while. It seemed like he was curious as to what these ’Leaders’ were capable of.
"Reinforcements? Really?"
He questioned as he noticed Faelara staring at him.
Faelara didn’t say anything.
She wasn’t ashamed.
After all, it was her personal dimension. No one could come here without her permission.
…other than some monsters.
Of course, such monsters were rare. No one else could come here, so if she summoned help here, it would be easier to overpower her opponents.
She was only using her Law to her advantage, like every warrior does.
"I need time to heal.
Buy some time for me."
Faelara spoke in a grim tone, completely ignoring Nux.
Her arm was still bleeding. She wasn’t like Vampires who could regenerate; she needed to rely on High-Level Potions and Healing.
She needed time.
"Be at ease."
Aerion nodded with a solemn look on his face.
Then, he stared at Nux and waved his hand.
Nux’s expression changed as he realized that something around him had changed.
However, Lysander wasn’t going to give him time to think as he rushed forward at an enhanced speed, wanting to close the distance between them…
But…
"What the hell is wrong with this place!?"
He screamed again.
No matter how much he ran, he couldn’t close the distance.
"The Space here is constantly stretching!
Faelara! Have you lost your mind!? Why are you fighting him in a domain he has such great control over!?"
Faelara was silent again.
She secretly stopped the space from constantly expanding, allowing these three to run as much as they wanted, and—
"I had no other choice…
Don’t worry, this one doesn’t last long either. You can now face him like you normally would."
She replied.
’Get his attention. I will look for a chance and end this.’
She spoke, her voice directly entering their heads.
The Leaders nodded.
This time, however, even they were a little skeptical of Faelara, but before they could think too much—
"You are a fun lot. You talk in the middle of the battle, allowing your opponent to restore his energy reserves. I guess it is your warrior pride, huh? Not to fight a weakened enemy? Quite noble."
Nux chuckled, even drinking a Mana Potion to add weight to his words.
Realizing the gravity of the situation, the Leaders looked at each other and nodded.
Once again, Lysander rushed forward, closing the distance between him and Nux. As he appeared next to him, a sword appeared in his hand, and he swung it, wanting to behead this man.
Alzar didn’t stay back either. He formed Spatial Cracks around Nux, and suddenly, Nux felt his body turning heavy.
Much, much heavier.
"DIE!"
Lysander shouted, prepared to behead Nux, but…
He simply stepped back and dodged the incoming attack.
"Huh…?"
Lysander widened his eyes in disbelief.
’A Sovereign… reacted to my speed…?
A Sovereign…?’
He couldn’t believe it.
He was amongst the fastest, even when compared to other Primordials. How did… a Sovereign dodge his attack?
’No!
This isn’t possible!’
Lysander was in disbelief. He tightened his grip around his sword and swung again.
This time, however—
Tap
Nux simply grabbed the blade of his sword with his thumb and index finger and—
"So one can stop me from teleporting,
One can manipulate the space around me to make it heavier and slow my movements,
And the last one can alter time around himself to increase his speed."
He realized what their Laws were and—
"That’s it?"
He tilted his head with a bored look on his face.
"I guess not all the foxes are interesting, eh?
I wondered if your Laws were worth getting, but meh, looks boring."
Nux shrugged as suddenly, he pulled Lysander’s sword towards him and—
BOOOOOOOM
He punched.
Obliterating the poor fox out of existence.
"Yep, this is how it is supposed to go."
He nodded with a satisfied look on his face.
"They are indeed your average side characters."
He then glanced at the other two, who had widened their eyes in disbelief.
Alzar was even prepared to run away, but—
"Too late, buddy."
Stay updated via freewebnovel
Nux teleported next to him and—
BOOOOOM
And while he was at it—
BOOOOOM
He got Aerion as well.
Just like that, the three reinforcements Faelara summoned were gone, but…
Faelara was nowhere to be seen.

Then, he stared at Nux and waved his hand.
Nux’s expression changed as he realized that something around him had changed.
However, Lysander wasn’t going to give him time to think as he rushed forward at an enhanced speed, wanting to close the distance between them…
But…
"What the hell is wrong with this place!?"
He screamed again.
No matter how much he ran, he couldn’t close the distance.
"The Space here is constantly stretching!
Faelara!
Have you lost your mind!?
Why are you fighting him in a domain he has such great control over!?"
Faelara was silent again.
She secretly stopped the space from constantly expanding, allowing these three to run as much as they wanted, and—
"I had no other choice…
Don’t worry, this one doesn’t last long either.
You can now face him like you normally would."
She replied.
’Get his attention.
I will look for a chance and end this.’
She spoke, her voice directly entering their heads.
The Leaders nodded.
This time, however, even they were a little skeptical of Faelara, but before they could think too much—
"You are a fun lot.
You talk in the middle of the battle, allowing your opponent to restore his energy reserves.
I guess it is your warrior pride, huh?
Not to fight a weakened enemy?
Quite noble."
Nux chuckled, even drinking a Mana Potion to add weight to his words.
Realizing the gravity of the situation, the Leaders looked at each other and nodded.
Once again, Lysander rushed forward, closing the distance between him and Nux.
As he appeared next to him, a sword appeared in his hand, and he swung it, wanting to behead this man.
Alzar didn’t stay back either.
He formed Spatial Cracks around Nux, and suddenly, Nux felt his body turning heavy.
Much, much heavier.
"DIE!"
Lysander shouted, prepared to behead Nux, but…
He simply stepped back and dodged the incoming attack.
"Huh…?"
Lysander widened his eyes in disbelief.
’A Sovereign… reacted to my speed…?
A Sovereign…?’
He couldn’t believe it.
He was amongst the fastest, even when compared to other Primordials.
How did… a Sovereign dodge his attack?
’No!
This isn’t possible!’
Lysander was in disbelief.
He tightened his grip around his sword and swung again.
This time, however—
Tap
Nux simply grabbed the blade of his sword with his thumb and index finger and—
"So one can stop me from teleporting,
One can manipulate the space around me to make it heavier and slow my movements,
And the last one can alter time around himself to increase his speed."
He realized what their Laws were and—
"That’s it?"
He tilted his head with a bored look on his face.
"I guess not all the foxes are interesting, eh?
I wondered if your Laws were worth getting, but meh, looks boring."
Nux shrugged as suddenly, he pulled Lysander’s sword towards him and—
BOOOOOOOM
He punched.
Obliterating the poor fox out of existence.
"Yep, this is how it is supposed to go."
He nodded with a satisfied look on his face.
"They are indeed your average side characters."
He then glanced at the other two, who had widened their eyes in disbelief.
Alzar was even prepared to run away, but—
"Too late, buddy."

Nux teleported next to him and—
BOOOOOM
And while he was at it—
BOOOOOM
He got Aerion as well.
Just like that, the three reinforcements Faelara summoned were gone, but…
Faelara was nowhere to be seen.

chapters.title: Chapter 1899: She won.
paragraphs: Just like that, the three reinforcements Faelara summoned were gone, but…
Faelara was nowhere to be seen.
Yes, the Fox had dipped.
She never relied on the three ’Leaders’ in the first place. She knew their strength, she had seen it firsthand; they never stood a chance against Nux.
Heck, they were the reason she had grown so arrogant.
Yes, Faelara realized her mistake.

She had gotten too arrogant because of the so-called ’power symbols’ around her. Even as a Divine, she knew that the moment she broke through, she could take on the three Primordials around her with a wave of her hand.
She wasn’t wrong. With how powerful her Law was, she could very easily crush the three of them without even trying, but…
This led to her being overconfident. To her, breaking through became a trump card that would let her deal with any threat she faced.
Even a monster like Nux.
And who could blame her?
Nux was a Sovereign, for God’s sake.
Believing that she would be able to deal with a Sovereign after becoming a Primordial wasn’t wrong.

Yes, it was a Sovereign who had destroyed Middle-Level Worlds, but honestly, even now, Faelara couldn’t believe that Nux did it on his own. She just thought that he must have used some trick to do that and believed that with her Law, she would be able to defeat him.
It was only now that she realized how wrong she was.
But…
What’s important was that she realized her mistakes.
What’s even better?
Her strongest suit wasn’t fighting.
She had the power over Space!
It was one of the strongest concepts in the Universe. If she decided to run away, not many could catch her.
But…
"You didn’t think this would work, did you?"
Nux spoke as he glanced in a particular direction.
He wasn’t a fool. He was facing a being who could manipulate Space; would he leave her with no way to track her down?
He had already ’marked’ Faelara like he did with Vulpiana. He could sense his energy inside her body anytime he wanted and teleport right next to her.
His stalker teacher’s ability was indeed quite helpful.
Nux stepped forward and teleported to wherever Faelara was.
"Did you miss me?"
He questioned with a wide grin on his face.
The reaction he got, however, was a strange one.
"I did."
Faelara nodded, and suddenly, she snapped her fingers.
Nux’s instincts screamed.
In an instant, time in his perception slowed down. He looked around and realized he was somewhere in Outer Space, with ten asteroids of different sizes surrounding him.
’Well, this looks familiar.’
He thought inwardly.
Then he looked around, trying to find what his instincts were warning him about.
And finally, he saw it.
A small black dot that had formed right in front of him. He had missed it at first because he was in literal space—he had grander things to worry about than some little black dot.
But…
Soon, he realized how wrong he was.
This black dot…
It was pulling him toward it.
Not just him, it even affected the heavy asteroids around him.
It was…
It was a fucking black hole that was getting stronger and stronger as it devoured more and more things around it.
’Shit!’
Nux cursed in his head, trying to teleport away, but…
Because of spatial instability, teleportation became impossible. He couldn’t get away. The reality was cracking. It wasn’t just the Space Laws—other Laws and Concepts were being affected by it.
It was as if the Universe was attacking him again.
’Her Law is too absurd.’
Nux complained in his heart.
He was helpless.
The black dot had grown to the size of a small marble and was now twisting the space around itself. Stay updated with freewebnovel
Whoosh Whoosh Whoosh
Nux felt the pull getting stronger and stronger.

He looked around, trying to find a way out, and soon, he realized the space was only unstable in the region around the black hole. If he somehow managed to distance himself from it, he would be able to teleport away.
With a plan in mind, Nux gathered his strength, trying to get away.
But then,
The asteroids moved and clashed with his body.
Crack
’Fuck!’
He cursed as his bones cracked. And as if that wasn’t enough, the asteroid didn’t stop; it continued to move toward the black hole, dragging Nux with it.
"Aaaggghhh!!"
Nux screamed, twisting his body unnaturally as he barely got away from the asteroid. This, however, didn’t solve his problem.
Whoosh Whoosh Whoosh
The black hole quickly devoured the asteroid that Nux had gotten away from and…
Its size increased.
And together with its size,
Whoosh Whoosh Whoosh
Its pull increased as well, making it even more difficult for Nux to get away.
What’s worse?
This wasn’t the end of it.
There were nine more asteroids, and as the black hole pulled them all…
BOOM
"Uggghhhh!!"
Another asteroid struck from the side. His bones on his arm cracked. He, however, could only ignore the pain and avoid getting dragged.
Then another asteroid followed.
Then another.
And another.
BOOM BOOM BOOM
They all collapsed inwardly. Some Nux was able to avoid, some he couldn’t.
BOOOOOOOOM
The asteroids even collided with each other, causing massive explosions all over the place. It was like a cosmic avalanche.
And Nux, together with the black hole, was caught in the middle.
He tried to maneuver, to fight against the force pulling him in.
But it was useless.
Every time he tried to push away, another asteroid struck him, slamming into his ribs, his skull, his limbs.
They were crushing him, battering him, forcing him toward destruction.
"Ugghhhh…"
Nux groaned, using all his might to try and resist.
"There are things even monsters like you cannot resist, Nux Leander."
Suddenly, he heard a calm voice.
It was Faelara.

The Fox stared at him as her golden eyes gleamed with intelligent light. Her long gown fluttered. Unlike Nux, who was barely able to keep himself from getting absorbed by the Black Hole, she stood still.
Like a graceful goddess that couldn’t be harmed by her surroundings.
That is, of course, if you ignore her amputated arm that still hadn’t grown back.
"How are you… fine…?"
Nux questioned, his voice hoarse as he was barely keeping up, holding onto the weight of his own body.
"Don’t rack your head over it."
Faelara shook her head, not answering.
She, however, did have a few words to say.
"You didn’t lose because you were weak. Quite the opposite, actually. You lost because you were too strong.
I won’t be like others and blame your arrogance. I’d be arrogant too if I was as strong as you."
Faelara then shrugged with a self-deprecating smile.
"Who am I kidding? I am quite arrogant even now. I will reflect on that."
The Fox then looked at Nux one last time and,
"If it is any consolation,
Know that after this,
I’d be in an extremely weak state for the next few decades.
Who knows? Your wives might be able to track me down and kill me. If they can get over the shock of your death, that is."
She muttered, and as if on cue, the Black Hole’s pull strengthened even further, and this time, Nux couldn’t hold on any longer and… was devoured.
And then… he was gone.
Swallowed whole.
There was no explosion.
No cry.
No final act of defiance.
It was just… Nothingness.
Faelara remained silent, staring into the void that had formed after the Black Hole disappeared, devouring everything around it.
To think this man was the last one to be devoured…
To think he resisted where even massive asteroids couldn’t…
’Monster.’
Faelara commented in her head.
Only now did she realize what sort of monster she was facing…
And now…
It was finally over.
And the moment the Fox realized it, her body collapsed. It was the cost of using a power she couldn’t handle.
"Haaahh… Haahh… Haahh…"
Her breathing weakened. She could barely move while her body drifted in space. The Universal Energy around her had already surrounded her, slowly consuming her.
Yes, she was in a dangerous situation. She might even die if she didn’t recover enough to teleport away, but…
Faelara wasn’t disappointed.
She won.
She did i-
"That was painful, you know?"
The Fox’s eyes widened in horror as she heard a voice.

chapters.title: Chapter 1900: That was painful, you know?
paragraphs: "Haaaahh… Haaaahhh… Haaahhh…"
Nux, whose body materialized next to Amaya, took deep breaths. There were no injuries on his body, he didn’t feel any pain, and he was in perfect condition.
However,
His mind was still hazy.
It still hadn’t recovered from what he had been through.
"Nux…?"
Amaya called out. In an instant, her face was filled with worry.
While the rest of the women were still talking, after Nux destroyed the Five Middle-Level Worlds, she returned to Nux’s Universe to cultivate again.

Yes, the Devourer was very serious and wanted to break through to the Primordial Stage as soon as possible. After all, the Dragon had already broken through, not to mention that new Vampire bitch was clearly eyeing her position as well.
To deal with them all, she needed to get stronger.
Yes, there was no way she would allow any bitch near HER husband.
Therefore, she was giving her all and was sparing no effort.
However, the instant Nux appeared in front of her in this condition, her expression changed, and she quickly went to him.
"Nux, are you alright?"
She questioned.
"That… that was painful."
Nux spoke, his voice heavy.
"Painful…?"
Shadow narrowed her eyes.
"It was…" Find your next read at freewebnovel
Nux couldn’t put what he felt into words.
For others, it was barely a few seconds, or maybe even less than that, but for him…
It was a long, long time.
This was the first time he truly understood… Nothingness.
It was unlike anything he had experienced before. No battle, no injury, no death could compare to this.
It felt like it was… his end.
He was in a place where light, sound, time, space, gravity, life, death, or any other concept—everything warped, stretched, and collapsed, all at the same time.
Nux’s body was pulled, twisted, elongated, stretched, and compressed infinitely in all directions.
His arms, his legs, his bones, his muscles—everything tore apart and reformed in the same instant.
It was an experience so agonizing that even someone like Nux felt like screaming, but…
No sound came out.
His thoughts scattered, his memories played in reverse, fast-forwarded, and looped back to moments he had long forgotten.
A crushing weight pressed against his very soul.
It was as if some force was unraveling his body, stripping him layer by layer until he could no longer tell if he was whole or fragmented.
His consciousness flickered, then dimmed.
It wasn’t like being trapped, or wounded, or even dying.
This was… Erasure.
An end so absolute it defied reason.
He was devoured by a force that didn’t care about who he was, what he had done, or what he could become.
Everything—his accomplishments, his power, his universe, his existence—it all felt…
Meaningless.
And while he was in this state, Nux’s highly active mind finally comprehended it.
A concept that no one else in this entire universe could comprehend.
One of the strongest Primordial Concepts.
Space.
And no, it wasn’t the half-bit Absolute Space that Faelara or other Foxkins had comprehended.
It was a Complete Law.
The Law of Absolute Space.
A Law that couldn’t be comprehended without being devoured by Space itself.
A Law one could only comprehend during the final moments of his life.
A Law that no living being should have power over.
But…
Nux Leander broke this rule.
He was devoured by Space itself, understood the concept of True Space during his death, and…
Returned.
"It was painful indeed…"
Nux spoke. His mind needed rest.
Yes, even his mind, which was broken and recreated until it was strong enough to store a world’s worth of information without losing anything, needed rest.
But…
He wasn’t done yet.
Nux stood up. His body momentarily lost balance, but Amaya was there to catch him. Nux chuckled when he saw his lovely wife standing next to him. Unable to control himself, he weakly sealed her lips.
Amaya smiled and brought her lips even closer to him, letting him take advantage of her body, and of course, Nux didn’t hold back either.
Since the meal had presented itself, it would be a sin not to taste it.
Slowly, he savored the pair of lips that were presented to him. His movements were still weak, but Amaya didn’t complain.
Her body squirmed. Even his slower-than-usual movements had a certain charm to them. The Devourer simply pressed her body even closer to Nux, wanting to be one with him.
Shadow, who stared at the Devourer shamelessly hogging the spot, stayed silent.
Nux seemed tired, so she decided not to butt in. Right now, however, Nux’s greed was extremely unstable.
Suddenly, Shadow was teleported right into Nux’s arms without her permission, and before she could even understand what happened,
Her lips were sealed as well.
Her line of thought broke down, her body melted in his arms.
Nux cuddled with his lovely wives for the next few minutes, and only then did his mind finally calm down.
"Mnh~"
Biting Shadow’s lip one last time, Nux distanced himself from the two women and smiled.
"I’ll be back soon."
"I’ll be waiting~"
"Can’t wait~"
The two women nodded before they turned towards each other and dangerously narrowed their eyes.
Yes, the two were prepared to fight it out.
Nux chuckled at the adorable scene in front of him. Then, he sensed Faelara’s energy and teleported next to her with a mere thought.
Something that shouldn’t be possible normally, since one would first need to understand where the woman was, know the exact place he needed to be, and calculate the energy required to move there.
But…
These were the limits of normal Laws or abilities.
For a being who understood True Space,
These things didn’t matter anymore.
With just a thought, he could appear anywhere he wished to, with no restrictions whatsoever.
"That was painful, you know?"
Nux spoke as he stared at the beautiful woman drifting in front of him.
The moment she heard his voice, Faelara widened her eyes in horror.
"H-H-How…"
She couldn’t even form words without stuttering because of how exhausted she was.
Her exhaustion, however, was the least of her worries.

Since the meal had presented itself, it would be a sin not to taste it.
Slowly, he savored the pair of lips that were presented to him.
His movements were still weak, but Amaya didn’t complain.
Her body squirmed.
Even his slower-than-usual movements had a certain charm to them.
The Devourer simply pressed her body even closer to Nux, wanting to be one with him.
Shadow, who stared at the Devourer shamelessly hogging the spot, stayed silent.
Nux seemed tired, so she decided not to butt in.
Right now, however, Nux’s greed was extremely unstable.
Suddenly, Shadow was teleported right into Nux’s arms without her permission, and before she could even understand what happened,
Her lips were sealed as well.
Her line of thought broke down, her body melted in his arms.
Nux cuddled with his lovely wives for the next few minutes, and only then did his mind finally calm down.
"Mnh~"
Biting Shadow’s lip one last time, Nux distanced himself from the two women and smiled.
"I’ll be back soon."
"I’ll be waiting~"
"Can’t wait~"
The two women nodded before they turned towards each other and dangerously narrowed their eyes.
Yes, the two were prepared to fight it out.
Nux chuckled at the adorable scene in front of him.
Then, he sensed Faelara’s energy and teleported next to her with a mere thought.
Something that shouldn’t be possible normally, since one would first need to understand where the woman was, know the exact place he needed to be, and calculate the energy required to move there.
But…
These were the limits of normal Laws or abilities.
For a being who understood True Space,
These things didn’t matter anymore.
With just a thought, he could appear anywhere he wished to, with no restrictions whatsoever.
"That was painful, you know?"
Nux spoke as he stared at the beautiful woman drifting in front of him.
The moment she heard his voice, Faelara widened her eyes in horror.
"H-H-How…"
She couldn’t even form words without stuttering because of how exhausted she was.
Her exhaustion, however, was the least of her worries.
